Our answer to these brainwashed, willfully ignorant, wannabe-cultists can't be just words. It must be through our actions: expanding access to the ballot, increasing voter participation, and swelling the voter rolls with newly registered citizens.
RUSH $25 or more right now to protect voting rights and to make every vote count in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081824_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=081824_3&amount=25]
Nothing is ever good enough for opponents of voting rights.
If the ballots are counted quickly and efficiently, reporting the results in a timely manner? " Oh it's rigged, no way they could have gone that fast ."
If precincts take their time counting the ballots and report everything at once? " Oh look how it all came in together, it's totally rigged ."
If the count takes a while, with precincts checking and reporting things all along the way? " Oh that took way too long, they were 'finding' more votes for themselves, that's completely rigged. "
These vote suppressors hold no logical position because they want you scared of voting and scared of our democracy. They think the only legitimate elections are the ones they win . And even then, opponents of voting rights will protest their own election race even if other races go the way they want for their party.
Team, these conspiracy theories have already been fired up even before a single vote has been cast. Chip in $25 or whatever you can to defend our democracy and our right to vote ahead of November's crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081824_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

These losers, liars, and conspiracy whackadoos don't understand how elections work. And they honestly don't care.
They are incapable of doing the simple math -- not just that 1 vote plus 1 vote equals 2 votes -- but that if every precinct is about the same size, each precinct will take about the same time to count, so of course the percentage of the vote counted and reported back will all come in around the same time.
Our elections are closely monitored. Electronic vote counting is backed up by human tabulation. Nonpartisan election workers monitor everything, and in many states, partisan activists are there to question and verify results as well.
None of that matters to these all-or-nothing, brainwashed sycophants who only want a demagogue to tell them who to blame for their problems and their anger and accept these lies without using an ounce of brainpower to question them. These weird people are out to destroy our democracy and to institute their own minority rule.
Fuel our work to fight back with $25 or however much you can today so that the truth can be known about our elections and we can make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081824_3&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=081824_3&amount=25]

name: John James
subject: ANYTHING is possible in America!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John James for Michigan
body:
| | | Friend,

My parents grew up in the Jim Crow South. Now, they are watching their son run for re-election in Congress.

I was taught that ANYTHING can happen in America, and that courage and honesty will always prevail. **That’s why I decided as a young man to attend the U.S. Military Academy at West Point.**

I spent eight years of active military service flying Apache helicopters in Iraq defending the American Dream my father lived.

**But today, that dream is in danger. **

We have Democrats calling for racial division and telling black and brown communities that they’re nothing without the government’s help.

_That’s not the America I fought for, and it’s not the kind of country I want to live in._

**I ran for Congress because I believe the American Dream should be available to EVERYONE, regardless of race, color, or creed. But, I need your help to defend it.**** ****I’m a top target for the radical Left. The DNC and DCCC are backing my opponent with whatever he needs, and I need your support to win this fight.**

subject: I will never stop believing in our future

body:

#
---
Team, I’m going to let you in on a secret. I’m a _huge_ “Ted Lasso” fan. It’s true! I’ve seen every episode (some of them more than once), and I could go _on and on_ about what makes this show so great. In fact, I even have a Ted Lasso “Believe” sign taped above the door to my office. For anyone who hasn’t seen “Ted Lasso,” the word “believe” plays a huge role in his life. Regardless of the circumstances we’re facing, Ted always preaches that we should believe in ourselves and whatever it is we’re doing. That same lesson applies to the work we’re doing now. This election has been long and challenging. Things haven’t always gone our way, but I have _never_ stopped fighting like hell to win this election because I believe we have a future worth fighting for. While Donald Trump is running on an anger and retribution-filled agenda that will drag us backward, Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz will move us forward by creating a future where our fundamental freedoms are respected and everyone has the opportunity to reach their full potential. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are working to lower your costs and protect your freedoms. And just like they have throughout their careers, they'll work with Republicans, Democrats, and anyone else to get things done for people like you. **_That’s_ the future I want for this country, and I know that we’ll be able to achieve it as long as we continue to believe in ourselves and the work we’re doing.** **[I believe that the future we want for ourselves is within our grasp. subject: What more do you need to know?

body:
We’re committed to doing everything we can to make sure we win this election at the ballot box, but we won’t have a chance if we don’t raise the resources we need to win. That’s why you’re so important to this campaign.
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Peter —
By now, you’ve probably seen all the evidence you need to know that Kari Lake can’t be allowed anywhere near the Senate. But U.S. Senator Kari Lake might be more likely than we think.
This race is closer than ever. First, a fresh poll showed Kari and Ruben tied. Soon after, a respected polling outfit projected Kari Lake as the likely winner in Arizona. And just a couple days ago, a brand new poll of likely voters in Arizona showed Kari defeating Ruben by one point.

**August 18, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
In this week's Sunday News Digest, we bring your attention to Governor Jared Polis's decision to [convene a special session of the 74th Colorado Legislature](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This session, scheduled for August 26, focuses exclusively on property tax legislation, stemming from the need to address escalating property taxes across Colorado—a concern many of you have shared in your feedback to us. Here's what you need to know.
* **Governor's Call for Special Session:** Governor Polis has officially called for a special legislative session after striking a deal to remove two property tax initiatives from the fall ballot.
* **Objective of the Session:** The session will deliberate on measures to maintain or lower future property tax rates, adopt stricter caps on revenue increases, and introduce a new framework for school district funding. These measures are intended to mitigate the burden of property taxes which, in some instances, have surged by more than 30%.
* **Bipartisan Cooperation:** Echoing the Governor's call, House Republican leaders emphasize the [necessity of bipartisan collaboration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). With Republicans in a significant minority in the State House, there is a critical need for both parties to work together to craft effective tax solutions that benefit all Coloradans.
* **Potential Impacts and Legislative Hopes:** The session presents an opportunity to secure tax relief for homeowners and ensure the financial sustainability of essential services. However, Governor Polis has made it clear he will withhold signing any legislation until certain related ballot measures are withdrawn, underscoring the session's high stakes.
* **A Call for Function over Theatrics:** Reflecting on past sessions marked by political drama, there is a collective hope among legislators that this special session will maintain a focus on constructive policy-making rather than devolving into theatrics.

As Coloradans face these significant legislative changes, we remain committed to keeping you informed and engaged. Your insights and opinions are invaluable to our community discussion, and we encourage you to share your thoughts on how these developments might impact you and your family. Read more [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Warm regards, Heidi Ganahl

# Actions Have Consequences (or at least they should)
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Peter,
One of the biggest factors contributing to most of our country's problems is the separation of consequences from people's actions. There is an eternal law that connects specific actions with natural consequences, and this law is being violated on an epic scale. Here are some examples: Student Loans Action: People borrow money and promise to pay it back with interest. Natural Consequence: People are required to pay back the money with interest. Separation of Consequences: The government transfers the debt to people who did not take a loan. Illegal Immigration Action: People break our laws to enter our country illegally. Natural Consequence: The people are turned away at the border or returned to their country. Separation of Consequences: The government provides free food, housing, healthcare, education, cell phones, and other services to these lawbreakers and requires law-abiding citizens to pay the bill. Over Spending by Congress Action: Members of Congress print, borrow, and spend trillions of dollars that we do not have. Natural Consequence: People vote these people out of office. Separation of Consequences: Incumbent members of Congress use government spending to "buy the votes" of their constituents. Shoplifting Action: People shoplift and 'smash and grab' items from hardworking merchants. Natural Consequence: Criminals are caught, prosecuted, imprisoned, and held accountable for restitution. Separation of Consequences: The government allows a person to steal up to $999.00 per theft with no consequence. Gang-organized smash-and-grab' operations are rarely prosecuted. BLM Riots Action: People damage and destroy public and private property by rioting in the streets. Natural Consequence: Rioters are caught, prosecuted, imprisoned, and held accountable for restitution Separation of Consequences: Most rioters are not prosecuted, and those who are receive light sentences. Unwanted Pregnancy Action: A man and a woman have sexual relations and create a life. Natural Consequence: Parents take responsibility for their children or put them up for adoption. Separation of Consequences: Abortion ends the life of the unborn child, or a deadbeat father justifies not taking responsibility by claiming the mother should have aborted the child. Men Competing in Women's Sports Action: Men cannot successfully compete against other men in athletics. Natural Consequence: Men who are unsuccessful in competing against other men could train harder or pursue other interests. Separation of Consequences: The biological male declares he is now female and takes awards, scholarships, and opportunities away from actual women and girls. Failing Schools Action: Most students cannot perform at grade level in Math, Science, and Reading. Natural Consequence: School District Leaders are fired, and parents are given the option to move their children to higher-performing schools, including public, private, charter, co-opt, homeschooling, etc. Separation of Consequences: School District leaders are given exorbitant salaries and leave with hundreds of thousands in severance pay. Elected officials refuse funding for parents to move their children to better-performing schools. These are just a few examples of liberal policies that separate consequences from actions. As Americans, we are free to choose our actions, but we are not free to choose the consequences of those actions. To preserve our Nation, we must return to conservative principles that hold people accountable for their actions. We should follow God's example of justice and mercy.
*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: [What do you perceive to be the United States' greatest challenges as a nation over the next decade? ](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZhI9DUXiw0iLEiDGvYYie1gEqZ5V3fCGs0WWSxvpAms0mLdTBALjML5HL5m8wwNwynUcU5tUA6wQkj6nw6N-Xq4msK5-eMckD34oxgf8Q9Kd6LD31yq9_FRe_d7V09EoZlDuHyR5dXVdjMVxz44XloRSeNhW67dj1CyonKf6NRs4oUQ0vJttwqu0hYxIT4pa2-ZdsYC0FnBoItFT7uo8RsMjy-q2pCK9&c=LSr3VsYiDDTG39zClCfBJ8-pLJr87Zb2Jrr0vb-ZNew8n2R7l3XSdw==&ch=wu7s8ZuvCwUpl-PaHjVtasGtI6R-oR5dsUiuuRnnFFaPTrR7W_inWA==) A: The national debt. Unrestrained illegal immigration. Woke philosophy in education and our national institutions. Breakdown of the rule of law.
Q: [Do you believe that compromise is necessary or desirable for policymaking? ](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZhI9DUXiw0iLEiDGvYYie1gEqZ5V3fCGs0WWSxvpAms0mLdTBALjML5HL5m8wwNwJdPDq9nISFZMRYRCqq9SQD8ulY36sHaexRzpciefFHmo2hISu7qP7whWpqSodvt_21i3dgbmF-N-DaBCo1bcI2XUSR0KQUSF0CBu4dwvidESn3UuGGEg-x_uKeOzjr_Wz4cHxdRCl6hNJrUGZbrQu6hcS736jOChlX6i9t3ZLgs=&c=LSr3VsYiDDTG39zClCfBJ8-pLJr87Zb2Jrr0vb-ZNew8n2R7l3XSdw==&ch=wu7s8ZuvCwUpl-PaHjVtasGtI6R-oR5dsUiuuRnnFFaPTrR7W_inWA==) A: Our country was founded on compromise. It is necessary in a democratic republic. However, we should never compromise on integrity, honesty, and ethics.

Peter,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Hardworking New Mexicans are suffering from these failures, and they demand new leadership in Washington who will improve, energize, and restore hope to our state and our country.

That’s why I’m running for Senate and **why over 8,000 voters across all of New Mexico’s 33 counties – _nearly 4 times the required amount_ – signed the official nominating petition to put me on the ballot. **

New Mexico is my home. **My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico, and it is here that I have always returned.**

I understand the importance of hard work, like most New Mexicans. I waited tables to help pay for my undergraduate degree from Georgetown University. While holding down a full-time job, I paid my way through night school at Georgetown Law. Then, I went on to Harvard Business School and graduated with honors while 9 months pregnant.

I began my career at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I have advised, invested in, grown, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. **Collectively, the companies I have been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.
| | | | [](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>>](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.)

August 19, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Rep. Pete Stauber Endorses Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress

ANCHORAGE, AK - It's official: Minnesota Congressman Pete Stauber, the
leading voice for American energy independence in Congress, has
endorsed Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress.

Stauber endorsed Dahlstrom all the way from Minnesota because he knows
that she will stand up to the out-of-touch anti-jobs activists trying
to kneecap America's energy production. Stauber understands that
Alaska's current congresswoman, Mary Peltola, is a rubber-stamp
Democrat who has supported the Biden-Harris administration's radical
anti-American energy agenda.

Mary Peltola stood by and supported Joe Biden as he signed over 60
executive orders targeting Alaska's energy exploration and production.
In May, Stauber stepped in to lead
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71291&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64560> the Alaska's Right to Produce Act, after
Mary Peltola abandoned her own legislation and encouraged fellow
Democrats to vote against the pro-Alaska energy bill.

<https://dfx1kn0n80mx5.cloudfront.net/email/image/9ced3adf0fac496b864c42
5659f6e9f8.png>

"Alaska and Minnesota have faced an onslaught of anti-mining and
anti-energy policies that have done nothing but destroy domestic energy
production and drive prices up," Rep. Pete Stauber said. "It is my
honor to stand up for Alaska's--and America's--energy future and that's
why I'm joining President Trump and supporting Alaska's Lt. Governor,
Nancy Dahlstrom, to be their sole congressional representative."

In response to the endorsement, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, who was
also endorsed by President Donald J. Trump, said:

"I am proud to have Congressman Stauber's endorsement in this critical
race. Congressman Stauber stepped up for Alaska when our own
Congresswoman turned her back on our state. I look forward to working
with Rep. Stauber and President Trump in Washington to unleash Alaska's
resources and fight for our great state."

| | **FORMER CIA OFFICIAL WARNS:** **DEADLY STRIKE COMING TO AMERICA'S POWER GRID** _**Can you keep your family safe when the lights go out?**_
---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8)
---
**Former CIA Director stunned listeners with a stern warning...**

An attack on America's infrastructure would _"blackout the national grid and other life-sustaining critical infrastructures for over a year. Killing 9 out of 10 Americans by starvation and societal collapse"._

In fact, attacks on just nine of the nation's 55,000 electrical substations could result in coast-to-coast black-outs, plunging millions into darkness for up to 18 months. Terrifying.
**OUR GOVERNMENT IS WOEFULLY UNPREPARED**
They ignore dire warnings from national security experts about our vulnerable power grid. Warnings of physical, electro-magnetic pulse (EMP) and cyberattacks...

And who suffers? YOU and your family. Imagine a blackout lasting months. Your life would be frozen in time right at the moment your power fails. An entire country plunged into darkness.

Without a generator, your fridge, electric range and microwave would be dead. All the food in your fridge and freezer – spoiled.

**That's why many Americans are taking matters into their own hands and are securing their own solar powered generator.**

Solar generators are a smart choice because they produce an endless supply of life-saving electricity when you need it most – and **without gas, fumes or noise**.

Our top recommendation in portable solar generators is the [**Patriot Power Generator**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8).

**THIS breakthrough solar generator is safe enough to use inside. And never needs gas, ever.**

And you'll have peace of mind knowing that you and your family have a safe, reliable and easy-to-use source of backup power. To survive a blackout, storm, grid-down event... or worse. It's why the Patriot Power Generator was recently featured on **Fox & Friends**...
**FOX & FRIENDS FEATURES BREAKTHROUGH SOLAR GENERATOR**
---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8)
---
Fox & Friends featured a breakthrough solar generator right before a "polar vortex" sent thousands of Americans into total darkness. Skip Bedell recommended it as the perfect gift to prepare for winter storms.

**_And then BOOM!_** _**Demand surged and 4Patriots sold out of generators.**_

Then a massive ice storm hit the nation. The folks who were fortunate enough to claim their silent, fume-free solar generator were thanking their lucky stars. Because despite power outages, rolling blackouts and bone-chilling temperatures...

Those who acted fast and got their **4Patriots solar generator** had peace of mind and could power critical devices like lights, space heaters, communications, critical medical devices and even fridges and freezers.

Sadly, those who didn't prepare were left to hope and pray the lights came back on soon.
[**SEE THIS BREAKTHROUGH SOLAR GENERATOR IN ACTION!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8)
---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8)
---
**YOUR LIFELINE: THE NEW & IMPROVED PATRIOT POWER GENERATOR 2000X**
The Patriot Power Generator 2000X now has double the capacity, more power, and newly expandable than our previous best-selling model.

It was designed to safely and dependably meet your power needs. And best of all, it harnesses the power of the sun to keep a state-of-the-art lithium-iron-phosphate battery charged, so it delivers life-saving power for FREE.

**Unlike other generators, you'll never run out of gas.** You'll have a power supply that you can recharge endlessly. And its portability is a huge advancement over chunky gas generators, or home-installed systems.

You can take the Patriot Power Generator 2000X with you if you are forced out of your home. You'll have an ample supply of AC electricity available to power your fridge, freezer, or medical devices.

Even your coffee maker... power your cell phones, computers, radios... and so much more. You can even use it to power an electric blanket to keep you warm. **NO DEADLY FUMES, AND SILENTLY STEALTHY** The Patriot Power Generator 2000X is a completely self-contained system that silently provides up to 2,000 continuous watts of totally FREE, renewable power. And it's so easy to use a child can use it.
* Unfold and set up the solar panel in the sunlight.
* Plug in the solar panel.
* Now plug in your electronic devices and enjoy free power from the sun!

Amazingly, it takes just 6 hours to fully charge via AC cord. It holds a charge for up to a year. **PLEASE DON'T WAIT
TO LEARN MORE** But don't delay. We can't keep these generators in stock. Once we run out, it could be a while before we can get you one. [**SEE THIS BREAKTHROUGH SOLAR GENERATOR IN ACTION!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8) To your survival,

Frank Bates
Patriot Headquarters P.S. Thanks to your support, we're able to provide support to important charities that help American veterans and their families. Charities like Fisher House, A Soldier's Child Foundation, Team Rubicon and Operation Homefront. **CUSTOMERS ARE RAVING ABOUT THEIR SOLAR GENERATOR**
---
---
**Joe B.**
"My Patriot Power Generator arrived four days before Ian "the beast" hurricane hit my town. It was a lifesaver. After losing all power, we would have been in absolute darkness with no way to communicate to the outside world. If we needed aid or rescue, it would have been impossible with dead phone batteries. The Patriot Power Generator was everything you said it was and more. I say this with tears in my eyes: I'll never be without at least one. Great product, people! You should be proud!"
**Bob A.**
"Could not be happier! Generator works flawlessly, solar works flawlessly, plus all the other goodies in the package are amazing! Would definitely recommend 4Patriots for all your generator and other survival needs! Just spoke with Sienna at customer service to say how much I love the products! Sienna was very courteous and professional!"
**Carla U.**
"The ice storms in February left us without any type of electricity for a solid week. If it wasn't for the solar generator, my husband wouldn't have been able to sleep with his CPAP and we would have been in the dark for a week. It was very helpful and very convenient to be able to keep it charging continuously by day in the sun. It's well worth the money. Get off the fence and order this for the safety and security of your family!"
**Bernice L.**
"Don't wait to add this vital piece of equipment to your preparedness arsenal! We were able to keep our lights on and our electronic equipment charged for 5 days when the power went out last year. As soon as we could, we purchased another generator!"
**Patricia T.**
"This is great not just emergencies, but everyday help as well! I needed to repair my shed, but there's no power out there, and most of my tools are plug-in electric. I was unhappily thinking about running 150ft of extension cords, then remembered my 4Patriots Solar Generator! Worked like a charm. Utterly reliable and easy to use. There's no good reason to put off getting back-up power! Peace of mind and convenience, too! Love it!"
[**SEE THIS BREAKTHROUGH SOLAR GENERATOR IN ACTION!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18466/6374453/efeef49c9f797ca306cd634e635c58a6ea6f58cd/29a668b4892f68cfbe6196835bd21b177b934ac8) **_

### **The time has come for “No Tax on Tips”**
---
A good idea takes on a life of its own.

**_“No Tax on Tips” is good for workers in multiple businesses throughout Minnesota and can be a reality in the next Congressional session with commonsense prevailing November 5 th._**

Don’t be fooled by imitators who are sudden converts. The White House has had more than three years to spearhead this idea – and could do it right now. In fact, the administration pushed for 80,000 additional IRS employees to enforce tip reporting and tax compliance.

Service industry workers supplement their incomes with tips.

Most customers at restaurants, clubs, or hotels view the tips they leave as voluntary gratuities. The customer is already paying for the actual product or service and their intent with a tip is to give thanks to a worker who has provided excellent experience.

|
---
We should not get in the middle of that transaction by putting onerous tax requirements on the back of workers.

**_Once in Congress, No Tax on Tips is a proposal I will work for._**

_I will seek new, innovative programs to help workers at all pay levels to keep more of what they earn. I do not see your pay as belonging to the government to do with as they please._

We need to ensure the nation’s workforce, which is currently being squeezed by high inflation, including high food prices, increasing housing costs, gasoline, and much higher interest rates.

**No tax on tips....now!**

---

---

---
**MY EXPERIENCE** as a District Court Judge, State Senator, State Representative, Hennepin County Commissioner, a veteran, and a small business owner gives me the skills and expertise to **solve** these problems.

**I’VE WON** in both Hennepin and Anoka Counties and I’ve door-knocked over 100,000 doors in this district. I **know** this district.

USO Supporter,
During these dog days of summer, we're celebrating our brave military working dogs and their handlers. For 82 years, military K-9 teams have faithfully protected our heroes in uniform and defended our freedoms in some of the most dangerous places in the world.
These brave K-9 teams risk so much -- now it's our turn to support them. [**That 's why we set a goal to raise $50,000 via email by midnight on August 22. Will you join us and give $29 now to support our military dog teams and all our heroes in uniform around the world who are sacrificing so much?**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/WYqRCr_)
[DONATE TO SUPPORT OUR MILITARY AND K-9 TEAMS*](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Summer is an especially challenging time for military K-9 teams. Not only do they face long days of scorching heat and humidity, but many of our service members are also far from home and missing precious summer moments -- family vacations, BBQs and their kids' baseball games. While the rest of us are enjoying the summer by the pool, military dogs and their handlers are putting their lives on the line to keep us all safe.
Dogs have a long history of serving alongside service members. In 1942, patriotic Americans donated healthy and capable dogs to join the World War II war effort. Some 20,000 dogs bravely served our country throughout the war and helped secure an Allied victory.
[**Please, can you give $29 to support our military working dogs, their handlers and all of our service members around the world bravely protecting our country?**](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/WYqRCr_)
[DONATE TO SUPPORT OUR MILITARY AND K-9 TEAMS*](https://links.e.uso.)
---
On behalf of our service members, both the two _and_ four-legged, thank you for your support,
--The USO

That means Trump and his allies will do just about anything they can to get in the way. They’ll ramp up their desperate attacks. They’ll continue blanketing swing states’ airwaves with ads against Democrats. You’re probably seeing some of this already -- especially if you live in a swing state.

# Rural Broadband

**Peter -** Have you used the internet today? Or high-speed WiFi? Probably so.

Think about all of the things in your life that require access to the internet, then consider all of those that simply do not have access to it.

In rural areas across the country, people don’t have access to the internet or speeds that support at-home jobs, schooling, and other necessities.

It’s true: we now live in the digital age, and the internet is no longer a luxury, it is required of us.

As the job market changes, especially after the pandemic, we know that being without access to high-quality internet cannot be considered an “option.” Even things like job hunting and shopping for basic household items have moved to a mainly online process.

Investing in rural broadband and improving access for rural Americans is a must.

With a new focus on giving these communities the access they need, we see that not only are jobs created, but that rural areas can finally catch up to the processes that make our lives easier and less time-consuming.

Peter - As someone who lives in a rural area, I can attest to the need for expanded access to this necessity, and I am ready to be a voice in Congress that will ensure that we improve and expand on this issue. In these turbulent times, owning gold and silver gives you control and a better outcome. body:
What a journey

**[THE STORY OF DONALD J. TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9i6evoji22t4ajighbh389a0o6hmmfitmfjdgfo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**

Friend, this email is longer than most, but we have a story to tell. **This story is about the greatest President in our lifetime who has endured more than any president in the history of the United States of America but never stopped fighting for the American people.**

* * *

We can't tell you how much it means that you opened this email. Did you know that only about _22% of Americans_ open these messages? Thank you for joining us.

This story is important, so we have a quick favor to ask - we're simply asking that you read this all the way through. _**[If you finish reading this and still think a $5 donation doesn't matter, we want to thank you for reading.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z97oek9f6fus0ekluv062uib4vsiudlbc4mlov8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**_ _We appreciate you and can 't wait to win in November._

While only about 22% of our friends are opening messages, only 1% go the extra mile by donating! That means you can join the **[top 1% of all Trump supporters.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z09sc06li55t7ui9pqham7nh54uorrcs9dgfbvl8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**

**[If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit - even just $5 - we could reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' big-money donors.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8g3spc0sbglvgul70togocugq5fko1j1tnn6ug8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
**[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z842baotkb878mdcqbo5m1fgt5361hvs2qg45120_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk5mf9dt91ktvlp1c63bjsesle8r6ibi3s948th8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Before the story begins, we have one question for you: _How did we end up here on July 13th, 2024?_

* * *

Well, here's the story:

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4439o303id6nnd9anatthhvo8afaf33rnqvopoo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Once upon a time, Donald J. Trump decided to leave his perfect life to help save our country. With one escalator ride, this nation was changed forever, and the **MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN MOVEMENT was born.**
**[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0mt64cmq9e9m1cudek779r6mq06lu0hj082hrb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm6hj3lrtnbfvdalkrv326h34203acnu42h7n950_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Donald J. Trump competed in one of the most competitive Republican primaries in the history of politics. One by one, he defeated all seventeen candidates to become the **[2016 Republican Nominee for President of the United States.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi8mbu33dlba9rau51ro96nanjh0f8d34tdfcjk0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3j58um7f33u1sbsekeh51u29hordrqjo6c3iv9g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za9osqf15a6f0o5nonaq1c719abg12picbb968u8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Democrats and the mainstream media were in disbelief. They lied about Donald Trump, called his supporters a **" basket of deplorables,"** and even rigged polls to ensure that Hillary Clinton would be the 45th President of the United States. Despite all that, the silent majority was silent no longer, and **on November 8th, 2016, Donald J. Trump WON the election.** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5fo0uol6ufvk8810lav6012msb3ou6996e677t8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbpgj89p36tblvb1ehh99g3cr8vqfsisd8mdlq60_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Donald J. Trump officially became President Donald J. Trump and gave his historic inaugural address straight to the American people. The media claimed this was a dark speech, but the American people knew we were about to enter an era of winning, and winning we did, like never before.

Our country began to FLOURISH, and the beginning of the greatest economy of all time had just started. However, Democrats began a nasty plan to try and take him down once again with multiple **HOAXES!** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9r87ltduo2j0vjvi2i3fe5vhvri6de66l73jf20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3pfhl1n1cln5klpkrsahkq1u7e3b58is432qqtg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

**[2017-2019](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrmlq9vlot7imj2kkomc6h4lms8lebulcsh4u2mo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**

President Trump's success was legendary.

\- He built the wall and secured our southern border
\- He created the strongest economy in American history
\- He ensured our military was the strongest in the world
\- He brought manufacturing jobs back
\- And so much more! **But this email is already too long, so let 's move on.**
**[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvcgiehc983rumrglvic8u36miqhmj2jng7283co_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsjapsebugrbs12ht6r0ucm79vkuidaunpgltlpo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)
Then, on December 18th, 2019, the radical Democrats **IMPEACHED** President Trump for doing absolutely NOTHING. The Democrats thought this would be the end of him, _but the story was just beginning. . ._ **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi09u36oi2jadofoeif5dci3q7qdvu557qdqvp3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmmd587cc3qgctk93ssivvs2vbbiv4llufs6uf88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

After the entire impeachment hoax was discredited and President Trump was VINDICATED, the 45th President wasted no time making our country great again. **2020 was off to a hot start until the COVID-19 pandemic hit.** President Trump never wavered and was the leader we needed during such a challenging time. **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsnkf05pt5qdclvh8dhdml9r1dgee9gfeqcc7ung_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdl8qasrsi501f514l2s9pf8sfa9u0u1hdcnfiao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

The 2020 election went back and forth and it was clear that President Trump was the more popular candidate. The Democrats and the Deep State teamed up to continue to slander him. COVID changed all the voting rules (some would say in favor of the left), and despite a huge lead early on election night, **Joe Biden was named the presumptive nominee.** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlalobonhkfao4oh076nrtotennf8rh30kor2mgg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg331e7r7edamf6f419vjtlj6he48e1nihremqho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

The entire country was angry with the election and the lack of transparency. **On January 6th,** President Trump gave a speech and said, _**" I know that everyone here will soon be marching over to the Capitol building to peacefully and patriotically make your voices heard."**_

Several Americans entered the Capitol with very little resistance even after President Trump asked for more security, **but Nancy Pelosi declined.**

Biden was officially inaugurated in January 2021, and the _country was terrified._ **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztkk82n7h65eh7es51vo1k0psbpnn3964mjljjko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zobf790q54jfr8pqesbmv9mh64q6lcbnl6qd02b0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

"Joe Biden" was now in charge, and the destruction of our country began.

**The economy was destroyed, dangerous WARS sprung up throughout the world, crime rose in the cities, inflation soared, and America turned to one of the worst versions of itself.** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfoijrhiaanr3f6eioi9aepg6bi2jgdgto34ojqg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z83lpgqfh9f37bresmjv6qcmhar0oeklfqtls840_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Fast forward to August 2022, **Donald J. Trump 's home in Mar-a-Lago was unconstitutionally RAIDED by the FBI** in search of classified documents. This was nothing more than a continuation of the neverending witch hunts brought on by the corrupt left.

This case was dismissed in July 2024. **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb2h93135qm2q2ip72e7ce6ch0r3875ult1m68gg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ze8rr5roalj1dkvlojqfojpuum7d96td39dlcf2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

Donald J. Trump. Betrayed. Slandered. Lied to. Cheated. He had a decision to make: _Do I enjoy retirement with my family? Or do I save our country?_

Once again, **Donald J. Trump stood up to Save America by announcing his 2024 bid for President of the United States.** **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7f5d465vav1rqokgl6rojktcilfdthmjr210q50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8jhjfr3cld95dv52kunu69kpj3btoucpgv6u9uo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

The Democrats couldn't stand to see the outpouring of support for Donald J. Trump's presidential race, so they cooked up countless witch hunts. **He was indicted four times in 2023. **

New York. Georgia. Washington, DC. Florida.

Liberals thought this would keep him from saving America, but they were wrong. _Support for Donald J. Trump skyrocketed to levels NEVER seen before._ **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z36pepd1m0kl8n2am0g870ve5mknuqkfvmbgml50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbmh7nqkh1ild7fclvl52hfce2jbj5vsvc7jntg0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

The 2024 Republican Presidential Primaries rolled around and, as a surprise to absolutely no one, **Donald J. Trump overwhelmingly won state after state.**

It was only a matter of time before his opponents _and the Democrats_ realized that America wanted **four more years of Donald J. Trump.** Other candidates dropped out one by one. **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zq63an9bq0pq77239fatklhbro4nu4ij8reaq75o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg6bctfira63qn6i8eglluduk5pcoaum19o7v4kg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)
It seemed like the witch hunts had reached a fever pitch, then the unthinkable happened.

A conviction. Making history, Donald J. Trump became the first former U.S. President convicted of felony crimes. To be clear, this was a **RIGGED** conviction and nothing more than a pathetic attempt to keep him off the ballot.

Democrats lied about him and called him a **" threat to democracy,"** **compared him to Hitler, and even said we need to put a "bullseye" on him.** The consequences were catastrophic. . . **[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zle0cn60bjujlcst3nn2c7kmmle5k2f02pi0b7oo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z16qmsi4a23ibfbn2ige7jvrilkt1ja7gl8pj2ho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c1ge9pb4c9h2bs)

We're not done yet. Just when you think there is no one and nothing else that could possibly come for Donald J. Trump, time froze around the world.

Friends,
Trump will be in Howell, Michigan tomorrow for his second visit since formally accepting the Republican nomination and naming J.D. Vance as his running mate -- and his 7th time since kicking off his 2024 campaign.
Howell also happens to be in my current congressional district, and I’ll explain why that’s important in a moment.
But first, I am asking for a contribution -- $3 or whatever you can afford — before Donald Trump gets here tomorrow. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to donate today:

## Republicans do not care about our military service members or veterans!
---
[](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=f275f04a4c&e=3818d77efc)
| Donald Trump recently stated, “The Presidential Medal of Freedom is better than the Medal of Honor because its recipients aren’t ‘hit so many times by bullets or dead.’”

He made this comparison while praising a billionaire donor who received the Medal of Freedom, essentially saying it’s better to be a billionaire who donates to him than someone who gave their life for our country. This just shows how the MAGA party, including my opponent Jeff Crank, is a party of billionaires, for billionaires. They don’t care about the lower and middle class or the sacrifices our servicemembers make.

We need your support now more than ever to defeat Jeff Crank and stand up for our veterans. Your contribution directly helps us combat this dangerous rhetoric and reach every voter in Colorado District 5.

Please donate today. Together, we can send a clear message that we honor our veterans’ sacrifices and reject the elitism of Trump and Crank.

The Democratic National Convention kicks off today in Chicago. I’m excited to connect with Democrats from across Texas and across the country as we support Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz and get fired up to elect Democrats up and down the ballot this November.
#TeamLizzie is working to win our #TX07 race and help Democrats here at home and across the country win their races, including Vice President Harris and Governor Walz. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240819?refcode=lpfe240819]

I have seen firsthand the difference in what we can do when Democrats are in the White House and control the House and Senate. We’ve made historic progress, from lowering the cost of prescription drugs to making generational investments in infrastructure. And we have all seen the risks to that work and to our values when Washington Republicans are in charge.
We have already seen the cruelty and chaos that characterize the Trump-Vance campaign, the GOP-controlled House, and the GOP agenda. Among other things, Project 2025—the GOP’s plan if Trump retakes the White House—proposes restricting abortions, birth control, and the abortion pill, eliminating checks and balances on the presidency, and abolishing the National Weather Service.
Those are just some of the things at stake, and there are just 11 weeks left until Election Day.
Each of us has an important role to play to help Democrats win at every level. One thing you can do today that will make a difference is make a contribution to support all the work we’ll be doing between now and November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240819?refcode=lpfe240819]

subject: Donate a Bible to someone in need today
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-yMlIIQdMFNoRY_BQ)
---
Dear Friend,

As followers of Jesus, we are all compelled to address a critical need that exists across the globe: **Billions of people wake up each day without the comfort and guidance of the Word of God in their native language.**

In some regions, entire communities have yet to receive a single verse of scripture, while others face a severe shortage of Bibles.

I'm reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the transformative power of the gospel.

**Will you provide Bibles to people groups who have yet to hear God 's Word with a gift today?**

Our commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that the gospel reaches every corner of the world.

When you give today, you will:
* Not only pass a Bible along but potentially change lives eternally.
* Help support over 3,500 IMB missionaries on the ground, teaching the Bible and bringing hope to spiritually lost communities.
* Answer God's call to share His Word with those who have yet to hear it.

You can click on the secure link below to make a donation of any amount and bring the transformative power of the gospel to those who need it the most.

[https://www.imb.org/generosity/gods-word-for-the-nations-confirmation/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-1iPYpIxiDSvQ)

Your support is more than a financial contribution; it's a beacon of hope, a lifeline to those who have yet to experience the love and salvation found in Jesus Christ.

Thank you for considering this urgent call to action. Together, we can make a difference in the lives of countless individuals and communities worldwide.

In faith,

Angie Shepherd
Journeyman Alumni

| Fellow Conservatives,

In Florida, **we back the blue,** and **I am so very honored that they back me too.**

**_I am endorsed by the Florida Fraternal Order of Police and the Sheriffs of Clay, Marion, Putnam, and St. Johns Counties._**

I look forward to working with our legislative leaders and our Governor to **keep Florida the most Pro-Law Enforcement State in America.**

We do not tolerate crime in our state nor do we tolerate disrespect to our courageous men and women who wear the badge.

I hope to EARN your vote and make you proud. **No one will work harder for Clay, Marion, Putnam, and St. Johns counties.**

If you have any questions, please email me back,
_**Judson**_

“I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative. Judson is a native of Northeast Florida, he runs a successful business, helps local charities, and is raising a family here. **Judson Sapp is a staunch supporter of law enforcement and understands the needs of our community.** I look forward to working with Judson as our next State Representative to preserve the Florida we all know and love.”
**-Putnam County Sheriff Gator DeLoach**
|

|
---
“Judson Sapp is a leader who understands the unique needs of our community. **He is an unwavering conservative and a steadfast supporter of law enforcement.** I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp to be our next State Representative.”
**-Clay County Sheriff Michelle Cook**
|

| |
---
“To ensure Florida remains the most law enforcement friendly state in the nation, we need legislators in Tallahassee who strongly support our men and women in law enforcement. **Judson Sapp is a solid leader we can count on to fight for our values, stand up for law and order, and represent Northeast Florida.** I am proud to support Judson Sapp to be the next State Representative from District 20.” **-St. Johns County Sheriff Rob Hardwick**
|

|
---

## Disaster Briefs
**Disaster Briefs** are your semi-regular summaries and headlines from around the world about natural and man-made disasters, climate change, disease and health, and international conflict. See endnotes for resources used in putting this report together. Data is retrieved, analyzed and summarized on the day of publication unless otherwise noted.
### **Meteorological/Climatological**
**Hurricane Debby** caused billions of dollars in damage on its journey from the Lesser Antilles to the British Isles. Though maximum sustained winds only reached Category 1 strength, rainfall from the storm flooded large parts of the southern and eastern coasts of North America. Peak rainfall reached more than 22 inches in Moncks Corner, South Carolina - the second highest rainfall total from any tropical storm in the state's history. The storm's unusual track and crawling-pace allowed rainfall buildup to flood most of the eastern seaboard.
**Hurricane Ernesto** - while far from the North American coastline - is moving slowly, as well, as it makes its way toward Nova Scotia as a Category 1 hurricane. Ernesto may still maintain tropical storm strength as it nears Ireland Wednesday night.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca8ad51d-8431-4c69-a19d-00e913faa107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Droughts in **Bangladesh/India** and **China** passed the eight-week mark, exacerbating existing food insecurity issues and political turmoil in the region.
### Disease and Public Health:
The World Health Organization [declared ](https://substack.com/redirect/75f23e39-5197-44c6-b10e-a52cad053451?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a public health emergency of international concern as the ongoing **mpox** outbreak worsens in Central Africa.
**H5N1** is widespread in North American wild birds and is causing outbreaks in poultry and U.S. dairy cows with several recent human cases in U.S. dairy and poultry workers.
Despite calls from experts, including federal COVID-19 whistleblower Dr. Rick Bright, the CDC has not launched a publicly-accessible data system or made detailed data available to the public.
Most human cases thus far have come from exposure to infected poultry, with slightly fewer from infected dairy cows. As of [the last reporting date](https://substack.com/redirect/5e6ad052-dee7-43d1-a0db-da3ba60a1666?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (8/7/2024) more than 100 million poultry have been affected.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b4bcb937-a789-49ce-8ac9-47a0dba7a05a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source:[ CDC](https://substack.com/redirect/434147d3-7f07-430b-9aa9-cf0f41fafa46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **International Conflict:**
**Afghanistan:** Afghanistan Experiencing "Continual and Significant" Drop in Religious Freedom Under Taliban Rule ([2024 Religious Freedom Report](https://substack.com/redirect/dd67b794-da9c-42bf-aa70-ed97375486d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). The U.S. federal watchdog on religious freedom noted corporal and capital punishment have returned, including public executions and flogging.
**Iran:** U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin ordered a guided missile submarine to the Middle East and expedited the travel of a carrier strike group equipped with F-35C fighter jets to the region; [Austin spoke ](https://substack.com/redirect/e5d1c89d-04f5-43cb-bd95-026e0fa979bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant about reinforcing U.S. capabilities to defend Israel as regional tensions escalate. Iran has vowed to retaliate for the July 31 killing of Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh in Tehran, which[ it blames on Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/29f8edc2-3f25-47a3-bae0-3944084c3e88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Gallant is currently[ a wanted war criminal](https://substack.com/redirect/d212a28e-e5d4-45d2-9f91-e390f94f52be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with arrest warrants in most countries in the world.
**Israel** : The 2024 Religious Freedom Report cited Israel's destruction of religious and cultural sites in Gaza as among "the worst violations" observed during the report period. Despite international calls for an end to Israeli strikes in the war-torn and civilian areas of Palestine, [including arrest warrants](https://substack.com/redirect/d212a28e-e5d4-45d2-9f91-e390f94f52be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) issued by the International Criminal Court, the United States remains dogmatically on Israel's side, proving munitions, intelligence and resources. Recent victories of pro-Palestinian majorities in both France and the United Kingdom, however, could leave Israel with only one major ally as it continues its genocide in Gaza. Israel has killed more than 40,000 people -- mostly women and children -- since the start of its assault last year, with the[ actual death toll estimated to be upwards of 186,000](https://substack.com/redirect/1e599e43-92fb-433f-8098-0674c10fdf54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Lebanon:** Risk of all-out war with Israel rose sharply after a retaliatory rocket strike killed a dozen youths in the Golan Heights of Syria, an area being illegally-occupied by Israel. Israel's military killed top Hezbollah commander in retaliation; Iran, Lebanon and allies are threatening retaliatory strikes against the rogue Israeli nation as it continues to wage attacks on foreign soil.
**Myanmar:** Wang Yi urged Myanmar to seek "political reconciliation" and get back on track with its democratic transition in yesterday's meeting, according to the Chinese readout; the appearance of the junta's head of command, Min Aung Hlaing, at the meeting dispelled some rumors he had been toppled [(](https://substack.com/redirect/3c8c6d31-477d-436b-b9a1-7a9f22ec055f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Nikkei](https://substack.com/redirect/3c8c6d31-477d-436b-b9a1-7a9f22ec055f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[)](https://substack.com/redirect/3c8c6d31-477d-436b-b9a1-7a9f22ec055f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Attacks near the China-Myanmar border in Myanmar's civil war have stoked concerns in Beijing [(AP)](https://substack.com/redirect/a8da0631-3bde-4c59-888a-4e8cd5108225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Pakistan:** While past International Monetary Fund (IMF) overhauls in the country have led to public protest, the military supports the current government's decision to hike tax collection and raise energy prices, unnamed analysts and officials told the _Financial Times_ [(](https://substack.com/redirect/494c8fff-b6af-4227-87a2-cdb6e55f5b13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[FT](https://substack.com/redirect/494c8fff-b6af-4227-87a2-cdb6e55f5b13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[)](https://substack.com/redirect/494c8fff-b6af-4227-87a2-cdb6e55f5b13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Political instability in the region continues to worsen, however, and parallels to interreference by the United States in Afghanistan have put American military officials on high alert.
**Ukraine:** Ukraine has [recaptured](https://substack.com/redirect/d8e612a0-a9bf-481f-8c10-bde404836b33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 54 percent of occupied territory, while Russia still occupies 18 percent of the country. Ukraine's counteroffensive efforts have [stalled](https://substack.com/redirect/b2611ae2-8b0c-40c4-a28b-cfab9c9f5992?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and Russia has opened a [new front](https://substack.com/redirect/d0406246-6fba-42e9-81c8-9607a4e35768?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Ukraine's northeast Kharkiv region.
Meanwhile, Russia continues to [bombard](https://substack.com/redirect/f4a4da88-f671-4c95-8cfa-7bd89b070301?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Ukrainian cities and [blockade](https://substack.com/redirect/b48a520d-612b-4d21-9eaa-655bcf4f2991?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its ports, and Ukraine has [stepped up](https://substack.com/redirect/d136b25e-6afb-4e6b-98df-ef47482d067d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) drone attacks on Russian ships and infrastructure. Since January 2022, Ukraine has received about [$278 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/35b47ba0-ef16-4b04-bf27-af561debe960?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in aid, including [$75 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/5320f435-b44c-4d42-8d08-d047f86af369?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the United States, though it warns of [donor fatigue](https://substack.com/redirect/68e3a5ca-6ada-4c3b-80af-11bb9d4ad825?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Fighting and air strikes have inflicted over 30,000 [civilian casualties](https://substack.com/redirect/93eb7f86-1cb9-4625-9a59-8f3a8982a2a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (still less than the number of[ confirmed causalities in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/1e599e43-92fb-433f-8098-0674c10fdf54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since October 8, 2023) while 3.7 million people are [internally displaced](https://substack.com/redirect/2058cc75-f992-4095-84d3-617cd71c5370?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and 6.5 million have fled Ukraine. 14.6 million people [need](https://substack.com/redirect/2058cc75-f992-4095-84d3-617cd71c5370?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) humanitarian assistance.
**Venezuela:** Nicolas Maduro claimed victory in the presidential election, triggering fraud allegations, international outcry and protests that turned deadly; popular unrest could rise in coming weeks, increasing risk of violent repression.

Get Out and Vote for Nancy Dahlstrom Tomorrow!

ANCHORAGE, AK - With less than 24 hours left before the primary
election tomorrow, now is the time to make your plan to vote for Lt.
Governor Nancy Dahlstrom.

Dahlstrom is the best candidate in the race to represent Alaska's
values in Congress. She is tough on crime, a champion of the pro-life
movement, and she has the experience to back it up. Alaskans are
looking for a real, conservative change in Alaska's sole congressional
seat. Alaskans do not need a congresswoman who puts her party politics
before her duties to her constituents, and there are plenty of polling
places
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71318&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64576> across Alaska for voters to send Mary
Peltola that message.

tomorrow, I hope I can count on your support. I am the only candidate

Dear Friend,

I am reaching out to you today with a particularly urgent concern.

A staggering number of people worldwide have yet to hear God's Word. They live in locations where the Bible is either completely unavailable in their language or in severe shortage. The issue is more than a lack of physical Bibles; it affects lives and eternities.

We believe in the gospel's transformative power for bringing salvation, but how can it transform if people cannot read or hear it in their language? Some languages have yet to receive a single verse of scripture, leaving these communities in spiritual darkness.

At IMB, we've tasked ourselves with the enormous, yet urgent mission of providing Bibles and Scripture portions to these unreached groups.

That's why I'm emailing you now. I urgently need your support to provide MORE Bibles and put MORE missionaries in the field to teach the Word of God.

Your gift is much more than a book. It's the gift of life -- eternal life. It's each lost soul encountered by God's grace, a community transformed, a language lit by the Scripture's light for the first time.

**Will you provide someone with a Bible in their language today?**

Here's the link where you can give: [https://www.imb.org/generosity/gods-word-for-the-nations/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9f615c322acd4416b495252cf6914ec8&_e=DIcmj9Y_F2f9V-oR7fd0VXePYBvG1ErufYkz6GieZbyOLAYHxlLkR0dqgU7gKd_6TP-OjFqPcNDJY2rtx3NpgoYJ8OuBOqyh-hCLdSbLJ_-cRPbujNQCo3fI5t8qoHAiQYQnVNWtbCEQDquPFGeMzX24zbc44-7RJNhowzuuj4LhoG8-Jf8Va1XxN94-HQST2kMsoqFH7_VThl-SmfqBG0_E4ysIkqCJqRYWE2n3JH05LEuRyoYwW8Yenu4Lls7m-y1bVwopzrxdwu2CLB5qfDefg5MM_4qVxNDVBfn-cRgD_WGzlDO7Afaz71Q9AxnVIiCa8P1XQ47X5fLoJAYCZlwdSIJlntr-Fbqr_qn5UiW1Wbph-guM20v7vi-zfB8A687Hwy0AnqV3tnlmw_Yn_w%3D%3D)

Thank you for your kind consideration. Your support can make a significant difference as we strive to bring God's Word to those who are yet to hear it.

Yours in Christ,

Angie Shepherd
Journeyman Alumni
Prayer and Missions Advocate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hello,
In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91111704/492752905/1610638071?refcode=em20240819mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=597d3c1b-445e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTdkM2MxYi00NDVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2NcPwzlQV1If0jDoctUpazJApbahx_Rje4Ly7ZGIZpw=)
In the end, though, the race went to a recount. **Lauren Boebert won by just 546 votes, and Adam lost the closest race in the entire country.**
Because here’s what their “models” and “forecasts” didn’t factor in: Adam put in the work. He traveled 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck to every corner of the district. He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he _listened_.

Trump even singled out Nevada’s Senate race during his RNC speech to ridicule her – and ever since, right-wing billionaires have poured millions of dollars more into Nevada to flip it red.

**There’s no pretty way to put it: We need to turn this around STAT ... or we’re TOTALLY COOKED.** Nevada’s last Senate race was decided by just 7,928 votes – so if Jacky’s opponent gets away with misleading persuadable swing voters at this rate, Democrats don’t stand a chance in hell of keeping our Senate majority.

name: Lindsey Scholten
subject: OLCV announces new board chair Paige Spence
body:
| | | Hi Peter, OLCV is delighted to announce that Paige Spence has been elected the next chair of OLCV's board of directors. Paige has been part of OLCV for many years — first on staff as Coalition Director and then as a board member since December of 2019. Her combination of political savvy, experience in the Oregon Capitol, understanding of OLCV from the inside, and connections to partner organizations make her an ideal chair. “I am humbled and honored to be OLCV's newly elected Board of Directors Chair,” said Paige. After moving to Oregon ten years ago, she fell in love with Oregon’s natural beauty. “As we all know, we must be stewards of ensuring the place we love is as beautiful and healthy for the next generations. Drought, water scarcity, wildfire, and other threats require us to engage in policy decisions to address them.” Throughout her years of involvement with OLCV, Paige states: “I know first-hand that the advocacy OLCV does every day is challenging – but well worth it. I look forward to working with you all to advance legislation and apply political pressure to keep Oregon healthy!” Paige is succeeding Jules Bailey, who is concluding his board service. "It has been an absolute honor and pleasure to chair the OLCV board for the last 5 years," said Jules. "When I took the position in 2019, none of us knew that a pandemic would upend all our lives and change the political landscape. But OLCV, because of the dedication and hard work of the staff and volunteers not only made it through COVID, but in many ways came out stronger. We now have an incredible new executive director in Lindsey Scholten, ready to power the organization forward for the next chapter by harnessing the power of OLCV's grassroots network to keep a pro-environment majority in Oregon. I'm delighted that Paige Spence has stepped forward to lead OLCV's board as we do so. Her vision and leadership are just what the OLCV board needs." OLCV is grateful to Jules for his many years of service, and we look forward to moving forward with Paige to begin a new chapter! Sincerely,
Lindsey Scholten
OLCV Executive Director |

Hey, y’all! We’re now less than three months away from one of the most critical elections in decades. Our campaign is heating up, and I couldn’t be more energized by the momentum we’ve built together. Every day, we’re one step closer to flipping Tennessee blue, and I’m excited to share with you some of what we’ve been up to. ⬇️
* * *
🎉 Celebrating Our Primary Victory 🎉 We celebrated a huge milestone this month: clinching the official Democratic nomination! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112576/492755850/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=) This primary victory belongs to you — our dedicated grassroots supporters. Your hard work and unwavering commitment have brought us to this pivotal moment, and we’ve entered the general election stronger than ever. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112577/492755851/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=) The movement we’ve built — made up of grassroots supporters from all walks of life — CAN defeat Marsha Blackburn in November. And we will.
* * *
🚗 Team G on the Move 🚗 I want to take a moment to say how incredibly proud I am of our campaign staff and volunteers. Team G has been working non-stop on the trail to mobilize folks and spread our message of hope across the state. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112578/492755852/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=) Last month, I had the pleasure of meeting people from all corners of Tennessee during our 95 County Tour. From White County to Cannon County, Rutherford County to Overton County, we’re making sure that every voice is heard. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112585/492755854/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=) I’ve met with faith leaders and educators, and I even had the chance to attend a reggae show, where I listened to voters share what issues impact them the most. It’s been inspiring to connect with so many Tennesseans who are ready for real change. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112587/492755943/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=) We also had a fantastic time at the Tomato Arts Festival parade with the East Nashtivists. We spread our message loud and proud to friends and neighbors, reminding everyone that their vote matters! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112589/492755945/209297649?refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=)
* * *
🗣️On the Airwaves 🔊 It’s been a pretty busy couple of weeks for podcasts. I joined **__[Steve Schmidt on The Warning](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112591/492755947/-803653937?v=ql6bHODS76c&refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=&emci=e5327ab4-395e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=46764483)__** to talk about the state of this race, and I also spoke with **__[SiriusXM Progress](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91112593/492755949/-1609795607?utm_medium=shared&refcode=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODczYWQzNi00NTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=04N1Rze1EIJKyb2bZ0fgjO_ZeJ5pa9lgTQtja5o0VMY=&emci=e5327ab4-395e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f873ad36-455e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=46764483)__** about women’s reproductive healthcare and why this election is so critical for abortion rights. Funny thing is, Marsha hasn’t said a peep about it! As a former educator of 27 years, I know firsthand the challenges they face — from managing crowded classrooms to making sure every student gets the attention they need. | | Today is the first day of the Democratic National Convention in Chicago, and I'm excited to celebrate all we've accomplished in the last four years with President Biden and see Vice President Kamala Harris officially accept the Democratic nomination for President. **Under President Biden's leadership, we've achieved so much for our country.** I've been proud to vote for landmark legislation that includes:
* A lifeline for our country and economy from the worst pandemic in our lifetimes through the **American Rescue Plan**
* The most significant legislation to fight climate change through the **Inflation Reduction Act**
* Historic investments in infrastructure through the **Bipartisan Infrastructure Law**
* The first gun violence prevention laws in decades through the **Bipartisan Safer Communities Act**
* Boosting domestic semiconductor production and easing supply chain constraints is showing promising results through the **CHIPS and Science Act**
* Improved healthcare access for our veterans and the largest healthcare and benefits expansion in VA history through the **Honoring Our PACT Act**
* And more!
