subject: Is Capitalism More Humane Than Socialism? Get the Free eBook
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsK9Z6vWNE
I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover
Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for
Capitalism."
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osK9Z6vWNE

Dear
Friend,
I'm
excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution,
"Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work
explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism
and its alternatives, and you can get your free copy at this
link.
In the
eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism
is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that
free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes
for consumers and workers.

Ayaan
Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist
Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom
and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how
economic systems shape individual lives.
This
eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers
scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts
on prosperity and well-being.
This
eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be
the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing
traction for socialist ideas.

Click
here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral
Case for Capitalism."

Best
regards,
Greg
Stamps

Greg
Stamps | Online Development
Hoover
Institution | Stanford University

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

| | Today is the first day of the Democratic National Convention in Chicago, and it's a historic one! [**Will you split a donation between my campaign and****the****Kamala Harris****campaign****right now to help Democrats win big in November?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91115179/492765076/164105795?refcode=2024-08-19-convention&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2fc3c140-4a5e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmMzYzE0MC00YTVlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0CbG5B8CikUIl7lURFWHfo3bnpWK0QboyMaGuH6wRgo=) **Under the leadership of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris in the past four years, here's what Democrats are delivering for the people:**
* Creating millions of American jobs
* Defending Ukraine's democracy against Putin's menace
* Fighting for reproductive health care for all
* Championing equality instead of weaponizing hate
* Returning microchip manufacturing to America
* Making historic investments in protecting our planet
* Rebuilding roads and bridges and passing the largest investment in infrastructure
* Defending the right of workers to organize
* Making college more affordable
* Protecting our democracy
* And more!

Team,

Welcome to Chicago! The Democratic National Convention has officially kicked off in our state, and I want to talk to you about why it matters for our mission.

While we are rallying together as a party and unifying around Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, this convention has another essential purpose: _**to build grassroots power and empower Democratic candidates in all levels of elections– not just the Presidential.**_

The truth is, we know that Illinois will go blue for Harris and Walz – but that doesn’t mean that all of our targeted countywide races will automatically do the same. For county level and less-publicized races that we work on, we often have to work a lot harder with fewer resources in order to win.

Let me be frank: Your dollars go a lot further in county races. These races are won or lost by a couple hundred votes, and your contribution makes it directly possible for county-level candidates to get out the vote, mobilize voters, and win. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_19_unopens_ndonor_2&n=4)
---
|
---
Dear Peter,
During my announcement speech more than a year ago, I said that I have so many skeletons in the closet that if they could vote, I would be king of the world. I knew much would be made of my past. I have been around politics. I know of its hazards.
I also knew that my vision and policies would inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you _declare yourself foe to widespread corporate-government corruption and declare yourself opposed to a runaway war machine_ (a war machine killing innocents and draining our country’s coffers), you will inspire resistance in the establishment. Put another way, many powerful people want to make sure the gravy train never stops. And I derail gravy trains.
When you point out the morbidity of our two-party system -- a system that our first president warned us about, a system that is now largely predicated on hating fellow humans -- **you will inspire resistance in the establishment.**
When you’ve spent much of your life successfully fighting against our biggest corporations and worst polluters; fighting against mining, timber, hydroelectricity, and oil industries on behalf of the voiceless and the indigenous; fighting against agribusiness barons blithely ravaging the lives of small farmers and small towns, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you remind Americans that censorship and other curtailments of our civil liberties always arrive burnished with a moral and patriotic gloss, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you invoke our crisis of meaning, our deaths of despair, the addiction, and the many children lost to screens, ill health, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you are wary of reductive partisan ideology and group-think; and when you refuse the common coin of today’s public discourse -- a glib second-rate cruelty delivered via the screen -- you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you assert that to better our country we must work toward a politics that heals this divide and affirms our mutual belonging, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_19_unopens_ndonor_2&n=5)
---
As you perhaps know, I am used to such resistance -- used to the bile and malign distortions that accompany speaking out on high-stakes issues. And I know that the establishment’s treatment of me -- while challenging -- makes perfect sense.
The dark and elaborately refined arts of partisan politics deployed to end my campaign (the documented censorship and shadowbanning; the out-in-the-open, anti-democratic, and well-funded attempts to keep me off ballots through expensive, complex, time-consuming legal challenges; the thwarting of debate access; the withholding of secret service protection; the paid staged protests; the sundry campaigns of defamation and scandalmongering) are the logical reactions of a threatened -- and very unwell -- status quo.
And underneath all of this -- underneath much of this election cycle, underneath much of this moment in our nation’s politics -- is a sort of destitution. A destitution of heart. It’s no small wonder so many people have withdrawn from civic life and democracy altogether.
**A broken bond needs to be reestablished in our country. We need more soul-searching and less partisan warfare.**
Our work as Americans, whether we like it or not, transcends all labels and all parties. It seems we will recognize this reality and act accordingly; or be broken into it. History is not made occasionally on great stages by the privileged few but made daily in the depths of each human soul. Ours is a beautiful nation, still.
According to the Internet, our country (and our world) is in chaos. But in post offices, parks, and grocery stores our beauty still heartens and shines. We all see it every day. It is in the name of that beauty that I work.
It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president.
**The true power of America is not its comfort, wealth, or military might, but its ideals of liberty, democracy, and generosity.**
This campaign is about honoring and restoring those ideals -- regardless of the defamation, evasion, and trickery. We knew those were coming.
We will not be deterred on this necessary journey.
[Yet, this dream will not be possible without your help today.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_19_unopens_ndonor_2&n=6)

subject: We need your help to help push Measure #4 over the finish line...
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by End Unfair Property Tax – Julie Googins, Treasurer](https://endpropertytax
body:
They’ve already spent $80,000 on polling to find the most effective way to mislead voters... | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/endpropertytax.com/joinus?e=d842fb25cc)

| Fellow North Dakotan,

I want to take a moment to personally thank everyone for all the hard work and dedication shown in getting us this far. What we’ve accomplished is nothing short of remarkable.

Because of the commitment of hundreds of volunteers, we’ve placed the property tax measure, Measure #4, on the ballot with thousands of signatures to spare.

But our work isn’t finished...

As you know, the opposition is doing everything they can to spread fear and misinformation, just like they did in 2012. They’re pulling out the same old playbook — same organization, same chairman, same tactics — trying to scare people into voting against their own best interests.

_They’ve already spent $80,000 on polling to find the most effective way to mislead voters._

But we have something they don’t: the truth and the support of people like you.

Our message is straightforward: Measure #4 provides the property tax relief and reform we’ve been promised for years, all while maintaining local control and full local funding.

The only obstacle now is getting this message out to as many people as possible, and for that, we need to raise funds quickly.

This is where I’m asking for your help once again—not just to donate, but to spread the word to others who believe in this cause as much as you do.

[If you can, please consider contributing 10% of one year’s total property taxes, $500, or whatever amount feels right for you](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=93c61423fe&e=d842fb25cc).

Every donation counts, and every dollar brings us closer to success.

And if you know others who might want to help, please forward this email to them. Encourage them to [visit our website](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=0164af57b2&e=d842fb25cc) where they can easily donate online or find the address to send a check.

We’re so close to making real change, but we can’t do it without your continued support.

Thank you for believing in this cause and for standing with us. Together, we can make Measure #4 a reality and END North Dakota’s unfair property tax.

Sincerely,
---
|

subject: A few words about the Medal of Honor

body:
Donald Trump has shown that he does not have the faintest idea of what valor means, or bravery, or self sacrifice. He does not understand these things, and he does not value them.
#
Peter,
You have no doubt heard Trump’s shameful comments about the brave few who earned our nation’s highest, most sacred Military honor — the Medal of Honor. In comparing the Medal of Honor to the Presidential Medal of Freedom, Trump’s degradation of the award we revere so highly is not his only error.
Despite Trump’s comments, there is no equivalent award to the Medal of Honor. None. It has been given to fallen Americans who shielded their comrades from grenades with their own bodies. Who dragged the wounded from harm's way, repeatedly, at the risk of their own lives. Who put themselves between the enemy and their friends against all odds, with complete disregard for their own survival. For outstanding courage, for self sacrifice, for extraordinary valor in combat.
In Trump’s case, you are awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom for being a political ally or a donor. And, apparently, he thinks that’s “better” than someone who receives the Medal of Honor. This is a window into who Trump truly is.
As I said, Trump’s degradation of this honor is not his only error. In doing so, he reinforces what we have known for years: Donald Trump does not have the faintest idea of what valor means, or bravery, or self sacrifice. He does not understand these things, and he does not value them.
A man who asked “What was in it for them?” at the grave of a fallen Marine cannot be trusted to order the finest, most powerful Military in the history of the world into combat. He cannot be expected to discharge the solemn responsibility that these fighting men and women are owed. But today, as you read this, Donald Trump stands on the precipice of becoming president once more.
It is up to us to prevent that from happening. Our Military deserves a leader with honor, with respect, with understanding. I’m proud to join VoteVets in their work to defeat Trump, once and for all.
And today, I am asking you to support that work.

And, apparently, he thinks that’s “better” than someone who receives the Medal of Honor. This is a window into who Trump truly is. As I said, Trump’s degradation of this honor is not his only error. In doing so, he reinforces what we have known for years: Donald Trump does not have the faintest idea of what valor means, or bravery, or self sacrifice. He does not understand these things, and he does not value them. A man who asked “What was in it for them?” at the grave of a fallen Marine cannot be trusted to order the finest, most powerful Military in the history of the world into combat. He cannot be expected to discharge the solemn responsibility that these fighting men and women are owed. But today, as you read this, Donald Trump stands on the precipice of becoming president once more. It is up to us to prevent that from happening. Our Military deserves a leader with honor, with respect, with understanding. I’m proud to join VoteVets in their work to defeat Trump, once and for all. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hello Democrats!
This email is our first that we will be sending you daily throughout convention week so you can keep up with all the excitement!
The Massachusetts delegation has landed in Chicago, and you can feel the energy in the city to kick off the DNC. Delegates from Massachusetts joined with the other New England states for a great welcome reception last night.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_0223%20Large.jpeg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_0394%20Large.jpeg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_0398%20Large.jpeg]
Today at our first delegate breakfast, we heard from our chair Steve Kerrigan, Maine Democrats chair Bev Uhlenhake, and Dems Abroad chair Martha McDevitt-Pugh, and other folks including former Ohio Democrats chair David Pepper, Joe Ricca of Dewey Square Group, Ed Kelly of the IAFF, Sam Briggs of Call Hub, and Dan Bianco Jr of LiUNA.
We heard their messages about the importance of togetherness, of motivation, of not stopping the work until the last ballot is cast. Our speakers were motivated, and so was our crowd!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/342B74464B38576236725655322B786B4F5745613342383863366E7541627678582B614B42435237506D71632B52373141636477486C6A7468424A6243423331/editor_images/IMG_1650.heic]
Tonight, we have the opportunity to say thank you to President Biden and share in the admiration and applause for his accomplishments. Preserving our democracy, stabilizing the economy after Covid, embarking on a historic run of job gains and wage growth, lowering costs on health care, prescription drugs and fees – the Biden-Harris agenda has been an unqualified success, and the President deserves the cheers he will hear tonight for all he has accomplished on behalf of the American people. We'll also be hearing from Dr. Biden and Secretary Hillary Clinton!
We hope you join us from wherever you are to watch tonight as President Biden
selflessly passes the torch to Vice President Kamala Harris and a new generation
of Democratic leadership.
You can take action today by Splitting a donation between MassDems and the Harris Victory Fund [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/massdemsxharris] or by signing up to volunteer here: mobilize.org/massdems
We also have some exciting new Massachusetts for Harris and Harris/Walz merch in our webstore! [https://store.massdems.org/]
Let's get this event started and get excited to elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz!
Onward,
The Massachusetts Democratic Party

| | | As if Trump hasn't disparaged our veterans and service members enough, he's gone and done it again! Trump said the Presidential Medal of Freedom, a civilian award, is "much better" than the Congressional Medal of Honor, which is the highest military decoration awarded to members of the armed forces. He said this while praising Republican megadonor Miriam Adelson, whom he awarded the Medal of Freedom while in office: _" That's the highest award you can get as a civilian, it's the equivalent of the Congressional Medal of Honor, but civilian version. It's actually much better, because everyone gets the Congressional Medal of Honor -- that's soldiers. They're either in very bad shape because they've been hit so many times by bullets, or they're dead. She gets it and she's a healthy, beautiful woman, and they're rated equal."_ Trump clearly has no respect for our veterans who put their lives on the line for our country. He absolutely cannot be our Commander in Chief. And he should apologize immediately. [**Sign your name: Demand Trump apologize to veterans for his despicable comments about the Medal of Honor >> **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0acab75f-e3c0-459a-a18e-aa7da557383d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Hi Peter Willis, it’s
Our Revolution Board Chair Larry Cohen and I’m on ground in Chicago as the
Democratic National Convention officially kicks off for the week.

The DNC will vote TONIGHT on the progressive party reforms we’ve fought
for since Bernie ran for president in 2016 — including permanently
reducing the power of superdelegates. This is our chance to make the Party
more democratic and responsive to the grassroots and less influenced by
corporate special interests — and we need your voice!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19264?source=email-20240819&t=1011&akid=6619%2E5885482%2EtQF58R ]Click here to tell DNC delegates to vote YES on critical,
people-powered rules reforms tonight at the Democratic Convention — and
win the progressive change we’ve been working for!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19264?source=email-20240819&t=1012&akid=6619%2E5885482%2EtQF58R ]ADD YOUR NAME

Since Bernie founded Our Revolution eight years ago, we have been working
to transform the Democratic Party nationally and, importantly, all 57
state and territorial parties.

The Unity Reform Commission, which I co-chaired, was launched by 1,300
Bernie delegates at the 2016 convention, and now these years of work are
paying off.

We have HUGE reforms on the table to reduce the power of superdelegates in
the presidential nominating process, allow independents and unaffiliated
voters to participate in primaries, and mandate that the 57 state parties
adopt same-day primary voter registration and vote by mail.

Last week, our organizing was supported by the DNC Rules & Bylaws
Committee when they voted to extend these critical reforms indefinitely,
and now our proposal will be voted on TONIGHT by DNC convention delegates
here in Chicago.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19264?source=email-20240819&t=1013&akid=6619%2E5885482%2EtQF58R ]Add your name and tell DNC delegates to vote YES and continue the
reforms our movement organized to win when Bernie was on the ballot.

Our work to make the Democratic Party more democratic and transparent is
essential to give progressives a real shot to win local, state, and
national elections. This work also includes the ongoing battle to ban Dark
Money from primaries.

As I like to say, "It’s the rules, not just the rulers, that matter." Our
commitment to ensuring the Party rules aren’t rigged is unwavering, and
your continued support and engagement are vital to our success.

Larry Cohen
Chair, Our Revolution Board
Member, Democratic National Committee

Hi, it's Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it's not in my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I'm under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I'm no stranger to uphill battles, and I know I can't do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don't need a title and I don't need a job, but I'm more concerned than ever about the direction of the country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to Washington.

**It 's no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I'm the underdog in this race. And that's why your support TODAY is so crucial.**

**_[So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in helping me continue building a strong campaign.](https://click.email1.larryhogan.com/?qs=e55e02b211ecf63552fb22b178c769b8fc47820805289cba1617b77804ebb8b38143936b58e96f12bcbef9b52f4a86777c59a622c61e248b51b605b4bba6e93e "So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in helping me continue building a strong campaign.")_**

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation didn't need to divide our state, and we got results! Let's get back to work again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across the country!
_**[Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?](https://click.email1.larryhogan.com/?qs=e55e02b211ecf635de204f829d2c90d9fb1c1c78aecfd41fa0d928752b24544348846226619a49d8269eb048fccf520c37aeaac13e2663b103a0947c1b5d5ad9 "Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?")**_

body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=081924_2&amount=25]
NYT: Supreme Court Sides With Republicans Over South Carolina Voting Map [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081924_2&amount=25]
We expected this, Team, even if it's bad news: The Supreme Court ruled 6-3 along party lines to overrule a panel of three federal judges that had previously ruled that South Carolina's 1st Congressional District was unlawfully drawn as a racial gerrymander.
A unanimous three-judge panel of the Federal District Court in Columbia, S.C., ruled in early 2023 that " the state’s First Congressional District, drawn after the 2020 census, violated the Constitution by making race the predominant factor ".

Hello, I hope that your summer is ending on a high note.
The DNC takes place this week in Chicago. I expect the Dems to run a high-quality event, and the energy will be high.
Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have been enjoying a honeymoon period despite most voters having little sense of either of their bios or backgrounds. Fleshing out who the candidates are will be a plus, as will the parade of Democratic dignitaries, from Joe Biden, the Obamas and the Clintons to up-and-comers like Wes Moore, Gretchen Whitmer and Josh Shapiro.
The Democrats have a raft of appealing figures and a rich heritage to draw on – note that at the Republican Convention there was no Bush or Romney hearkening back to fondly-remembered past administrations. It was really the Trump show.
4 years ago I spoke at the DNC, but it was a virtual event due to COVID and I beamed my remarks from a studio in Manhattan. They approved my speech down to the word and timed it down to the second. There were multiple reviewers. Every speaking slot is highly in-demand and the planners want to dole them out only to the few who are integral to the message and story they want to put forward. People imagine a raucous affair, but in contemporary politics it’s a tightly scripted and choreographed made-for-TV special. Or at least that’s what the goal is, as in a live arena more spontaneity will emerge.
The main variable will be whether protestors make it into the broadcast – when I attended a Joe Biden speech in South Carolina earlier this year there were multiple protestors during his address. Thousands of protestors are expected outside the Chicago convention hall at a site a half-mile away and 30 delegates are ‘uncommitted’ and thus natural protestors. One would think that it would be tough in this context to get tons more people inside the hall given heightened scrutiny of party delegates and attendees. But there will definitely be some protestors in the building. In South Carolina, pro-Biden chants quickly rose to up to drown out any protestors, and countermeasures will be robust.
The second variable is whether the Dems decide to invite and include moderate Republicans and Independents in the primetime speaking slots. In past conventions they included figures like Mike Bloomberg and John Kasich. This year, the possibilities include folks like Mark Cuban, Liz Cheney, Adam Kinzinger or Geoff Duncan, the former Lt. Gov. of Georgia who has endorsed Kamala Harris. It would serve to broaden the anti-Trump coalition and I hope they do this, but they might not as the time slots are very coveted.
The third thing to keep an eye out for is if someone emerges and creates buzz for the future with a particularly outstanding speech the way that Barack Obama did in 2004. It hasn’t really happened since, but a half-dozen people will certainly try to make the most of the platform.
The Democrats will put on a good show and the Harris-Walz ticket will, I expect, get a polling bump out of it. The expectation is that afterwards the race will tighten and remain close throughout, with the next major catalyst on the schedule being the first presidential debate on September 10th. The Harris campaign is also putting more policy meat on the bone out there and weighing taking unscripted interviews.
Will the race follow its expected course? In many ways, the goal of the DNC is to minimize any surprises. But in this cycle, surprises may be par for the course.

AFP ENDORSES VIKRAM!
Today Americans for Prosperity announced that they are endorsing Vikram in his congressional race! AFP is the premier conservative grassroots organization in the country and their support carries a lot of weight. They don't just endorse candidates; they work to help them win!
See below for the article announcing the endorsement.

| MANCHESTER -- Americans for Prosperity Action is backing Vikram Mansharamani's Republican primary bid for the 2nd Congressional District. In a statement, AFP officials said Mansharamani, a Lincoln entrepreneur and economist, earned the backing by committing to cut wasteful spending and take actions to secure the southern border.
"He supports making Congress work for us and not the other way around," said Greg Moore, AFP's regional director.
"AFP Action will be working tirelessly to ensure that he is successful and gets the chance to bring New Hampshire values to Washington. It's high time we had someone in Congress who actually lives up to our motto of "Live Free or Die.'"

Peter, Much has changed in our nation's politics in just the past few weeks. With President Joe Biden dropping out and Vice-President Kamala Harris entering the race, it's transformed the dynamic of this election dramatically. Whereas it seemed like Trump was cruising to an almost certain win over Biden, now his campaign seems to be struggling to adapt to the new reality that he is running against a much different candidate.

Little that Donald Trump says or does surprises me anymore, but I admit to being especially confused by his recent decisions to focus his remarks on crowd sizes and attack Kamala Harris personally rather than hitting on the key issues that Americans are concerned about: problems like the economy, the border and her record.

As I said in an interview the other day, this is the same playbook Trump used in 2020, and it's a losing strategy. If he allows this election to be about personalities instead of the real challenges facing the country and his vision for the future, he is going to lose this election. [You can watch my comments here](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=800cb07314d64e448ba9ab06a515d06c&_e=1BBxB_JkE9LD2i8L3INh356GzZTSlnnT8D7hrc2BJ8gPOX40zvKDAc4qal6LlgvTnxcYuOmE7KQx-jPYXcs93m2qTGSupNu32725H_V18WrgOmwMdCc_kGo4XboUyFk6nv6SOgOeN4il4gsMgrHeYTov0TTzftlp5pXxaCmsNrJ7bpHAiwjzkdiR7Vua22nF3fUTNt-Nn8405xFifHflN2mNUadeI-NKOFHX3pmbGGd1_qs73MZfWOKsLer7f_qZ6PeAA70bzV-HcdhLFGMvULCrUfTU9vPINyIGgi5co-W_I3iwg1ZI4z4ETvcje79Ob9ptBskee7C_R1H_LReOzNQq1AdOI-dfraf9sWzPBeA%3D):

The Democratic Party is in Chicago this week for their national convention. What I'll be watching for is whether they can have as successful a convention as Republicans did and come out of it seemingly as unified as the GOP did last month in Milwaukee.

Shortly after Harris accepts her party’s nomination, we'll soon head into Labor Day weekend. After that date is when we'll really start to get some reliable polling data that will indicate how voters feel about these two candidates.

There are plenty of polls out there now, but I don't take them too seriously because we know that historically independent voters don't often make their decision until after Labor Day. And these voters are the ones who are likely to decide this election in key battleground states like Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.
**I also wanted to call your attention to two other important items:**

For those who have worked in or around New Hampshire Republican politics, you likely know the name Ruth Griffin. I was saddened to hear about her recent passing. She was such an incredible lady and I was proud to call her a friend. [You can read more about her here](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=800cb07314d64e448ba9ab06a515d06c&_e=1BBxB_JkE9LD2i8L3INh3-DFUTNBOgKQgtbJ8a3zWO4ACwKggC-iPwueyFPf5Jvz4rXVfj6uo2uk97jPPurCUBijS2GfpABXSDna2_HVxrG_qa9_QF-0VUz3DTjdWwAs_R7d9kp1gDidzVFA448ZCqHQ2Z7Pv2zME-DtScfJyc9bwvdrMo-WfBh-36B-huiofhONlabI18LaO1BdmQ3T7yhki_RN18FdeqP0sS5fLddxYR9wGbLNrBE7l_c20WRtc71_x9CkDLZ9NG4sYxki37GoYc07IdAcdxOWbVojFHM%3D).
Also, I recently [wrote an op-ed](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=800cb07314d64e448ba9ab06a515d06c&_e=1BBxB_JkE9LD2i8L3INh33YlK3hf-2wQ72Kv6s1eij6Yy-IPFW80wEL367cppd4LF3lGZqlDhlNEOldo1a4URKfv2fKo8h2TFizLydQdgrljr0unmX113WYque_IZrHBE_T1i24Nw2OoVyra8C6vdsc28uAgGnoVaPIzkEsC_pZvUF6WXoaQdNqwHb8EkUsXo0Su7FX0DSH92GvpLG7rpOWXXV9zX5NQ1pq2nSSP08ut_KSNzMya513Fm-fcolCxburXTX1VKynh4j5EDcqDBTMrZ5iX-_6s7AXI7EA_4NFSUY6vJ1zOpYbo7J7vQ59DZGbjitJ8A0o5b36scqbu3w%3D%3D) to educate folks about the history of Congress' control over America's budget. You may remember that I spent much of my 18 years in Congress as a member of the House Budget Committee, ultimately serving as its chairman. I’ve also travelled the country urging state legislatures to vote for a balanced budget amendment to the US Constitution.

The Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974, signed by President Nixon while he was facing risk of impeachment, established the House and Senate Budget Committees and the Congressional Budget Office to guide lawmakers in establishing and enforcing spending plans. That historic law also created a process for Congress to create a budget each year along with procedures to enact the spending and revenue measures that that budget envisioned.

[You can read the full op-ed in the L.A. Times (here)](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=800cb07314d64e448ba9ab06a515d06c&_e=1BBxB_JkE9LD2i8L3INh33YlK3hf-2wQ72Kv6s1eij6Yy-IPFW80wEL367cppd4LF3lGZqlDhlNEOldo1a4URKfv2fKo8h2TFizLydQdgrljr0unmX113WYque_IZrHBE_T1i24Nw2OoVyra8C6vdsc28uAgGnoVaPIzkEsC_pa1NG7fcG1Zmjm-J1AVtDpfmAhmXs1lSQHWi8TzBKB9IGwICFZ0beWEINxQ0fHGeGm9_W8BIoAPDwntkd3phIx4cnCeyhSv1VaApKsIkwB3KRI-nyzRhRLbHoL3px2u-9-GkEhhz2tRgxSV93Udf6S2_a5GniF2p5EIpiX9wg5Qqw%3D%3D).

clean_body: Much has changed in our nation's politics in just the past few weeks.| | | Peter, Much has changed in our nation's politics in just the past few weeks. With President Joe Biden dropping out and Vice-President Kamala Harris entering the race, it's transformed the dynamic of this election dramatically. Whereas it seemed like Trump was cruising to an almost certain win over Biden, now his campaign seems to be struggling to adapt to the new reality that he is running against a much different candidate. Little that Donald Trump says or does surprises me anymore, but I admit to being especially confused by his recent decisions to focus his remarks on crowd sizes and attack Kamala Harris personally rather than hitting on the key issues that Americans are concerned about: problems like the economy, the border and her record. As I said in an interview the other day, this is the same playbook Trump used in 2020, and it's a losing strategy. If he allows this election to be about personalities instead of the real challenges facing the country and his vision for the future, he is going to lose this election. : | | | ---|---|--- The Democratic Party is in Chicago this week for their national convention. What I'll be watching for is whether they can have as successful a convention as Republicans did and come out of it seemingly as unified as the GOP did last month in Milwaukee. Shortly after Harris accepts her party’s nomination, we'll soon head into Labor Day weekend. After that date is when we'll really start to get some reliable polling data that will indicate how voters feel about these two candidates. There are plenty of polls out there now, but I don't take them too seriously because we know that historically independent voters don't often make their decision until after Labor Day. And these voters are the ones who are likely to decide this election in key battleground states like Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. I also wanted to call your attention to two other important items: For those who have worked in or around New Hampshire Republican politics, you likely know the name Ruth Griffin. I was saddened to hear about her recent passing. She was such an incredible lady and I was proud to call her a friend. . Also, I recently to educate folks about the history of Congress' control over America's budget. You may remember that I spent much of my 18 years in Congress as a member of the House Budget Committee, ultimately serving as its chairman. I’ve also travelled the country urging state legislatures to vote for a balanced budget amendment to the US Constitution. The Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974, signed by President Nixon while he was facing risk of impeachment, established the House and Senate Budget Committees and the Congressional Budget Office to guide lawmakers in establishing and enforcing spending plans. That historic law also created a process for Congress to create a budget each year along with procedures to enact the spending and revenue measures that that budget envisioned. . | I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can. . Will you please consider chipping in right now to help with this important cause and ensure that we can keep up the fight for a better America? I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John | | | Get the Latest Updates: | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.JohnKasich.com

As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: We have put New Mexico in play—something the Left never saw coming. | Peter, Yet another poll is out on the New Mexico Senate race that shows us closing in on Martin Heinrich. Here’s what the latest poll shows: We’re only six points down Heinrich polling his lowest ever at only 40% 21% of voters are undecided! Remember, this is a seat that the mainstream media is telling us was supposed to be safe blue, and the Democrats NEVER thought would be in danger. It is telling that a career politician like Heinrich— who has been in the Senate for over a decade —has 60% of voters in his “safe blue” state not ready or willing to vote for him! This is a clear sign that voters in New Mexico are fed up with the radical and destructive agenda he and the Biden-Harris regime have been pushing on us. It’s no wonder we outraised Heinrich last quarter and continue to close in on him! We have put New Mexico in play, Peter—something the Left never saw coming. The Democrats have a big surprise coming— Can you spare a few bucks? Thank you again for your support! For New Mexico, Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. subject: Fox News’ hypocrisy on Trump trashing veterans and military service
body:
Trump said a civilian medal of honor was “better” than the one given to soldiers because they are “either in very bad shape because they’ve been hit so many times by bullets, or they’re dead.”

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91127447/492809629/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWYxMWU2MjYtNjE1ZS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6fLbX8Q7kvIYPr2w80D81D0cBn5597iLUGTEVj1YCrM=&emci=39711220-615e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=1f11e626-615e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
On the campaign trail in New Jersey, Donald Trump once again trashed veterans who were injured or killed in the line of duty.
**At a rally, he claimed the Presidential Medal of Freedom, a civilian award he gifted to a Republican billionaire, was a “better” award than the Congressional Medal of Honor typically bestowed to military personnel.**
His reasoning? The Medal of Honor goes to veterans who are “either in very bad shape because they’ve been hit so many times by bullets, or they’re dead.”
It’s a disgraceful comment from a former President that echoes Trump’s belief that John McCain wasn’t a real war hero because Trump likes “people who don’t get captured.”
**So how is _Fox News_ covering it?**
**You guessed it, they’re not. Instead, they’re swift-boating Tim Walz.**
[**We’ll get into the details in a second, but if you’d like to help COURIER hold _Fox News_ accountable for their hypocrisy, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91127448/492809630/-593472309?refcode=20240819-EM-FoxNewsWarHeroes&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWYxMWU2MjYtNjE1ZS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6fLbX8Q7kvIYPr2w80D81D0cBn5597iLUGTEVj1YCrM=)
Since Kamala Harris announced 24-year veteran Tim Walz as her running mate, Donald Trump, JD Vance, and _Fox News_ have breathlessly smeared his service, accusing him of “stolen valor.” The attacks are eerily similar to the 2004 Swift Boat attacks on John Kerry.
That’s by design. Chris LaCivita is now a senior adviser to the Trump campaign and has been extremely influential for Trump’s 2024 run.
_Fox News_ has devoted hours of coverage to amplifying the attack.
Of course, _Fox_ smearing Democrats as unpatriotic is nothing new. There’s the swiftboat campaign against purple heart recipient John Kerry in 2004. The outrage over President Obama’s Marine salute in 2014. And, more recently, sharp criticism for President Biden because he supposedly checked his watch during a ceremony for deceased Marines in 2021.
**Meanwhile, Trump has repeatedly and publicly expressed disdain for veterans and fallen soldiers. Trump famously attacked late Senator John McCain for being captured in war in 2015, insulted Gold Star families in 2016, and called fallen soldiers “suckers” and “losers” in 2018.**
But you won’t hear about any of that on _Fox News_.
Here at COURIER, we hold _Fox News_ accountable for its hypocrisy in real time. If they don’t talk about Trump’s antipathy towards veterans, we will. And we’ll correct the lies they spread about Tim Walz and other Democrats, too.
We’re committed to telling the truth, and our fact-based reporting in our eleven battleground states exists to set the record straight and call out the lies on the right.

From the Philadelphia City Council to the White House, One PA is fighting back now. **If you’re ready to get involved, check out these three links (👇👇👇) or read our email from Saturday below.**
* [Sign our petition to the Philadelphia City Council](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91128625/492813565/-162895570?ms=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_hdr&refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEyZGVhNDgzLTY0NWUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=odRC64-0jKqhyc6M3qYqVb88DNy19Q9_KoOgzSie0xI=&emci=6af79d01-565e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=a2dea483-645e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=3825287)

\- One PA
---
**Whether it's racist slumlords like Donald Trump or developers displacing Black communities from West Philadelphia to Pittsburgh,** big, corporate real estate developers have had control over our democracy for far too long. They buy our politicians. They raze our neighborhoods and erase our history. They price communities of color out of their homes so they can make a quick buck. **To them, we’re just commodities — people sitting in apartment buildings where they can double the rent or houses they can flip at record prices.** **But it doesn’t have to be this way — and at One PA, we’re fighting back. Here are three ways you can stop Trump and local developers right now:**
# Tell the Philadelphia City Council: Side with working families, not corporate landlords.
The fight to keep the South Philly Sports Complex together and save Philadelphia's Chinatown is much bigger than just one or two neighborhoods. Every single proposal put forth will radically reshape our entire city — from putting pressure on our public transit and increasing traffic to skyrocketing rents and pushing local businesses out. **And the City Council can protect Philadelphians from the havoc these redevelopments would wreak on our city.[Sign our petition now and tell the City Council to side with working people, not big corporations:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91128628/492813568/694266023?ms=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_l1&refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEyZGVhNDgzLTY0NWUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=odRC64-0jKqhyc6M3qYqVb88DNy19Q9_KoOgzSie0xI=&emci=6af79d01-565e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=a2dea483-645e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=3825287)** | [Sign the Petition](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91128629/492813569/694266023?ms=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_sbt&refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20240819_na_rentcap2_team_nc_act_xx_sbt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEyZGVhNDgzLTY0NWUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=odRC64-0jKqhyc6M3qYqVb88DNy19Q9_KoOgzSie0xI=&emci=6af79d01-565e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=a2dea483-645e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=3825287)

# Join One PA’s social team.

Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

Today marks the first day of the Democratic National Convention. Later this week, Vice President Harris will speak as the official Democratic nominee for President of the United States, representing a truly historic moment for our country. To celebrate, we’re asking you to join us at one of 150+ watch parties right here in Pennsylvania!
**We have 77 days left to win this campaign and protect our fundamental freedoms in this country — and it’s more important than ever to get involved and celebrate this history making moment!** **[Can you click here to sign up for a watch party today?](https://www.mobilize.us/2024pavictory/?event_type=15&tag_ids=24395?source=em20240819-2-9296)**
We know the threat Donald Trump poses to our fundamental freedoms, and we know the risk our democracy faces if he’s given the keys to the White House again. The stakes in this election could not be higher. But with Vice President Harris as our nominee, I know Democrats can defeat Donald Trump this November.
But we need your help. The road to the White House runs through our Commonwealth and we need all hands on deck to deliver Pennsylvania for Kamala Harris.
**Can we count on you to join us this week?**
**[Sign up today for a watch party with our coordinated campaign!](https://www.mobilize.us/2024pavictory/?event_type=15&tag_ids=24395?refcode=em20240819-2-9296)**

Not only is it the start of the Democratic National Convention, it’s also the one-year anniversary of our campaign kickoff. = | | = With the support of this grassroots team, I became the first woman and person of color to represent Delaware in the House. Now, I'm running to make history again in the Senate. Only three Black women have come before me to earn this honor, so I'm facing one of the largest glass ceilings in American politics. name: John Carney
subject: Bethany Hall-Long Is The Best Choice for Governor
body:
https://www.johncarney.org [https://www.johncarney.org]

Friend,

Thank you for everything you've done to support my campaign for Mayor.

Today, I wanted to send a different message. I'm urging you to support Lieutenant Governor Bethany Hall-Long to be the next Governor for the State of Delaware.

Over the last several weeks, Bethany's opponents have distorted the truth and misrepresented the facts about her record .

I know Bethany as well as anyone in public life. We've served together for 20 years. Bethany has the heart of a public servant, and will work tirelessly for the people of Delaware as our next Governor.

Together over the last eight years, Bethany and I have :
* Invested in raises for educators and more funding for low-income students.
* Turned a $400 million state budget deficit into a $500 million surplus.
* Rebuilt our economy, creating more than 30,000 new jobs.

Bethany has been a real partner during my time as Governor. And I have full confidence that she is the right person to take on this job next.

Click here to donate to Bethany's campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bethany-hall-long?refcode=website] and help beat back the distortions spread by her opponents.

Thank you again for your support, and let's go win on September 10th!

John

| | Fellow American,
---
I'm speechless. There is demonic evil walking among us, as it always has. But it is no longer veiled in shadow, rather it walks out in the open. We read the Old Testament about children sacrificed to the demon Moloch, and how it was detestable in the sight of the Lord, but those days are not ancient history, but rather America's reality.

Today, the Democratic National Committee is holding its convention in Chicago, a city overrun with death. As if murders and drug overdoses aren't enough—the convention is promoting free abortions. Planned Parenthood is bringing a mobile abortion station to abort babies at the convention. The mobile "clinic" will also be medically sterilizing men. The DNC has officially become the party of sterilization, death, and destruction.

---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=75bd888726314fbb8acafbca09c96b7b&_e=IhmVesg1s6CFjA0G9Qnvuh_NWe7mLQa1j3hTWBjFdwbj0Uo4hzwZtY-1PZ2nFfsbjjPiBUopny-72Hop0gTEWfSYErP6ffYugrrvmAeIhut76p3m3k_FgOlMKbo2tzG2Jm4wjz_khmq2BaoStflGfZE-S8GDMoxlqI4sZWeqUpdISdIAu9y9B9YP18ciZKNSDL4Seie_n9W-sZ39_pSnGfupPI87OJnKYUWLfFgkbfUzTBJdNaxDZakI9KOWEUQ6Ln17vWtFy6mXDJPZ9ELtCgZ0AQ4H9JSeySGLPjOKlRvxMOymxQcbhWycBFPtOZmI)
---
The DNC is the party of death. It’s not enough to kill babies. They want to emasculate and sterilize America. The left hates families and hates children because they are the Lord's design and plan for humanity. This is nothing more than a rejection of Him. We, here at Hold The Line, are committed to the Truth, no matter how evil the foe we face. So what can we do?

Pray. We have spent the year praying for America, but I am calling for us to pray for the Democratic National Convention. I can't help but remember Matthew 5:44-45, "But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous."

Despite all the evil that is descending upon Chicago, God's presence is there. There is no one too far gone for the Gospel. God turned Saul into Paul, the most prolific author of the New Testament, and I believe that out of this convention could rise a new leader for the Gospel!

_**Will you join me, as the body of Christ, in praying for God to pull hearts out of the depths of darkness in Chicago? **_

body:
This month, students and teachers across Virginia – and the country – are heading back to school for the start of the new school year.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91130913/492821991/830632711?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-08-19_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjczMjA3Y2ItNmE1ZS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xn7Ha8c7gT2tVhmnpQnxCYLpFTNCD4ge7_gdw9iS6KA=)

| Peter,

This month, students and teachers across Virginia – and the country – are heading back to school for the start of the new school year. It is an exciting time for so many families like mine; we just sent our daughters back to school – one in high school, one in middle school, and one in elementary school!

subject: weapons of war

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

There are many issues on our agenda. But one of the deadliest problems
we’re working to address is our nation’s gun violence epidemic.

There are too many guns — especially semiautomatic weapons — in this
country. They are far too easy to access. And when those who seek to harm
others have access to a type of device known as a bump stock, the danger
that these weapons pose becomes even more grave.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140494?t=1002&akid=35920%2E1203867%2ElDP4U3 ]Will you sign on to tell Congress to finally BAN bump stocks?

Bump stocks turn legally purchased semiautomatic weapons into machine
guns. They’re what was used during the 2017 Las Vegas shooting, which
killed 60 people and wounded 500. Bump stocks are weapons of war — and
they have no place in civilian life.

Now, our extremist, far-right Supreme Court has overturned a regulation
classifying bump stocks as machine guns, effectively legalizing these
deadly devices.

Peter, seven years
after Las Vegas and hundreds of more mass shootings later, we’re not going
back. It's time for Congress to do its job and protect our communities
from the gun violence epidemic by finally enacting a nationwide ban on
bump stocks.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140494?t=1003&akid=35920%2E1203867%2ElDP4U3 ]Will you sign on and tell Congress that a ban on bump stocks is long
overdue?

Sign On

Bump stocks create weapons of war. And weapons of war do not belong in our
communities.

Thank you for taking action,

Justice Democrats

Fellow Patriot,

Election season starts very soon. Next month, early voting will begin and ballots will be deployed to voters.

_**So will thousands of Radical Leftist ballot chasers ...**_ They've learned that chasing down ballots issued to voters who wish to vote absentee or early is their greatest advantage in winning elections.

I know we can beat them at their own game.

body:
Democrats across the country are ready to win in November.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240819&t=1&akid=1076%2E587540%2EDFPz6y)
Peter, I’m pretty excited to be at the Democratic National Convention in Chicago this week! 🔵🗳️🇺🇸
I’m looking forward to speeches from some phenomenal Democratic leaders like President Joe Biden, President Barack Obama, and Secretary Hillary Clinton.
And of course, I can’t wait to hear from Tim Walz and Kamala Harris, our future Vice President and President of the United States!
Can you feel the momentum, Peter? I sure can! But I’m not forgetting our core mission with all this excitement: **[I’m setting a goal to raise $10,000 from online donations before the gavel closes the convention on Thursday. Will you pitch in $5 or anything you can to help us elect young progressive leaders?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240819?refcode=em20240819&amount=5&refcode2=1076_587540_DFPz6y&akid=1076%2E587540%2EDFPz6y)**
**Today more than ever, I’m proud as hell to be a Democrat and an American.**
The energy in Chicago is next level. Democrats from all across the country are ready to win in November – and that’s exactly what this convention is all about.
Together, we’re going to defeat the rise of the MAGA movement and stop Donald Trump’s cult from tearing apart the progress we’ve made over the last four years and threatening the foundations of our democracy with the GOP’s disastrous and dangerous policy agenda.
Together, we’re going to take back the House, keep the Senate blue, and elect Tim Walz and Kamala Harris at the top of the ticket. We’re also going to win big in state legislative elections – one of our biggest focuses at Leaders We Deserve!
If you’re watching the convention – or if you happen to be in Chicago like I am – I hope you’re as pumped up as I am about electing Democrats this November.

Together, we’re going to take back the House, keep the Senate blue, and elect Tim Walz and Kamala Harris at the top of the ticket. We’re also going to win big in state legislative elections – one of our biggest focuses at Leaders We Deserve! If you’re watching the convention – or if you happen to be in Chicago like I am – I hope you’re as pumped up as I am about electing Democrats this November. I’ll share more updates from the DNC soon. Thank you!!! David Hogg Leaders We Deserve

Dear President Biden,

I have one thing to say to you: Thank you.

You have accomplished so much, and saved our country from the nightmare that Donald Trump left behind.

I remember how excited I was when you won in 2020.

I have had your back since you became President, and I am so proud of everything you've done for working families in our country.

You capped prices on prescription drugs.

You protected good-paying union jobs.

You passed historic legislation addressing climate change.

You have done everything in your power to strengthen our Democracy.

I have zero doubt in my mind: _You will go down as a truly GREAT American President._

**I respect your decision to step aside from the race, and I truly thank you for putting the country and our Democracy first — that is something that Trump and the Republicans will NEVER do.**

[**I'm signing this letter and sending a small donation of $3 with VPP now to show that I'm still fighting — for our country and for your legacy, Mr. President. **Up until now, the Ds and Rs had a fundraising advantage of literally 100X!** The maximum contribution to either of the two big parties is about $600K, while the max for the RFK Jr campaign has been $6600. We were fighting with both hands tied behind our backs.
But now, their advantage has narrowed to just 10 to 1... we're fighting with both hands now! [This is our moment to close the gap.](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=xZnUFBVfzxP3S2MDqRIKWNv3qebSLVDDckpTWrhd8sTWN6X_XH5ifX8zF5qJZHChDWFz3KyDKKs85_arc_VEnBUyjbefHlpW6sFn9zA3BxKVQdDEPAqz2roCxCssLu7_lfqA0H9pCao1gHsAtwAheVChrxxhmLPzasH4JRiord0SqwDtfWRL0OIA66bCbStjkxm4Z5PJq2_VMuzgZTDTWg&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=victory_fund_2_8_19_all_nd1&n=5)

So far, the American Independent Party of California has joined, and two state Libertarian National Committee (LNC) parties. As more LNC state parties join, the maximum will increase by $10,000 for each state. The maximum could grow to more than $550,000!

Voters from all walks of life are rallying behind a leader who’s serious about tackling the climate crisis head-on. And we’re right there with them. Kamala Harris has an impressive track record on climate action, and it’s worth taking this moment to highlight it. **[But before we dive in — can we count on you to split a contribution between the Harris campaign and our team at JanePAC? Your support will help elect Kamala Harris and more climate champions like her this November.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91136662/492842270/1555083529?refcode=ea.f3d74f6d-785e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f3d74f6d-785e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzZDc0ZjZkLTc4NWUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q9mvqT75tArjHCDEvJkZgWS9GNu0skrMiX0UG-vTIys=)** | [**SPLIT A DONATION**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91136663/492842271/1555083529?refcode=ea.f3d74f6d-785e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f3d74f6d-785e-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzZDc0ZjZkLTc4NWUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q9mvqT75tArjHCDEvJkZgWS9GNu0skrMiX0UG-vTIys=)

_**Kamala Harris’s Biggest Climate Wins:**_
✅ **As California’s Attorney General:**
* Harris took on some of the biggest polluters in the country. She launched a **groundbreaking investigation into ExxonMobil** for misleading the public on climate risks and held Volkswagen accountable for emissions cheating, securing an $86 million settlement.

* She didn’t stop there. Then-AG Harris also **took legal action against Plains All American Pipeline** after a devastating oil spill in 2015.

✅ **As a U.S. Senator:**
* Kamala Harris was an **early co-sponsor of the Green New Deal,** pushing for bold action to achieve 100% clean energy by 2030 and fighting for environmental justice in communities long overlooked.

* She introduced legislation to get **toxic lead out of our drinking water** and to transition our schools to clean electric buses.

✅ **As Vice President:**
* VP Harris was instrumental in passing the **Inflation Reduction Act,** the most significant piece of climate legislation in recent U.S. history.

* On the global stage, she’s represented the United States at key climate summits, securing **billions in climate aid for developing nations** and spearheading initiatives to promote climate resilience and adaptation.

Now, here’s the thing: while we’re all pumped about Kamala Harris’s nomination, this is no time to sit back. We need to keep the pressure on her to go even further on climate action if she’s elected. This means supporting climate champions at every level, staying active in the movement, and demanding bold legislation that meets the urgency of the crisis we’re in.
**Our collective action can ensure that climate justice remains a top priority, from the local level all the way to the White House.**

clean_body: The best is yet to come! | The Democratic National Convention kicks off tonight, and the energy is already off the charts. Voters from all walks of life are rallying behind a leader who’s serious about tackling the climate crisis head-on. And we’re right there with them. Kamala Harris has an impressive track record on climate action, and it’s worth taking this moment to highlight it. = | = Kamala Harris’s Biggest Climate Wins: ✅ As California’s Attorney General: Harris took on some of the biggest polluters in the country. She launched a groundbreaking investigation into ExxonMobil for misleading the public on climate risks and held Volkswagen accountable for emissions cheating, securing an $86 million settlement. She didn’t stop there. Then-AG Harris also took legal action against Plains All American Pipeline after a devastating oil spill in 2015. ✅ As a U.S. Senator: Kamala Harris was an early co-sponsor of the Green New Deal, pushing for bold action to achieve 100% clean energy by 2030 and fighting for environmental justice in communities long overlooked. She introduced legislation to get toxic lead out of our drinking water and to transition our schools to clean electric buses. ✅ As Vice President: VP Harris was instrumental in passing the Inflation Reduction Act, the most significant piece of climate legislation in recent U.S. history. On the global stage, she’s represented the United States at key climate summits, securing billions in climate aid for developing nations and spearheading initiatives to promote climate resilience and adaptation. Now, here’s the thing: while we’re all pumped about Kamala Harris’s nomination, this is no time to sit back. We need to keep the pressure on her to go even further on climate action if she’s elected. This means supporting climate champions at every level, staying active in the movement, and demanding bold legislation that meets the urgency of the crisis we’re in. Our collective action can ensure that climate justice remains a top priority, from the local level all the way to the White House. = = Let’s do this. \- The Jane Fonda Climate PAC | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended an anti-carbon capture pipeline rally in Buckeye, A postcard writing event in Marshalltown, the Humboldt Co Dems dinner in Humboldt, spoke with the leadership of the 4th District Dems via Zoom, had a get together with folks in Sibley in Osceola, spoke to a packed house at a house party in Blencoe in Monona County, and doorknocked with my friends Penny Vossler (who's running for state house) and Herman Quirmbach (current state senator) in Boone.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Before I get to my postcard writing ask, a quick story from my door knocking in Boone Sunday. I knocked a Republican door, and met a nice guy in his 30's. I asked him what was top of mind for him, and he talked about his wife, who has Type 1 Diabetes. He talked about the immense cost of medicine, and how stressful it is considering he is a seasonal laborer. We then talked the role of politicians in that space. We discussed the efforts of the Biden administration to cap med costs, and how a Republican U.S. House Representative here in Iowa accepted a big donation from Big Pharma (link below) the same day she voted against that cap. We agreed that shouldn't even be a partisan issue, that it's just shameful that disproportionate corporate power continues to press its thumb on the scales everywhere we turn. My first bullet on the stances side of my hand out card I handed to him jumped out: I have always and will continue to reject corporate PAC money.
Now, to the ask. Last campaign, thanks to my amazing volunteers, we sent out 5700 post cards. This campaign, as of now, volunteers have already committed to writing double that mark. Let's keep that momentum going! Post card writing for us is a very, very easy thing to do. My post cards have some of our major stances on one side, so the cards do much of the work for you already. My ask would just be that you write a simple note, and if possible, if you could cover the postage as an in kind contribution to help us out, as we're a grassroots campaign. We'll mail you the cards and the name & address list along with some basic prompts. We don't want to send a generic mailer as those typically get tossed in the garbage, but post cards written by someone are attention grabbers.
If you're interested in helping us get the word out, please email me at melton4iowa@gmail.com and we'll get moving. If you'd like to help but aren't interested in writing for us, a donation would go a long way in buying more postcards. Thanks!
Our schedule for this week: On Tuesday, 8/20, I'll attend an anti-carbon capture pipeline rally in Marathon put on by the Sierra Club at 6 pm. On Wednesday, 8/21, I'll be speaking at the Nevada Progressives Ice Cream Event at the library in town at 7 pm. On Thursday, 8/22, I'll be speaking at 2:45 at the AFL-CIO Convention at Prairie Meadows in Altoona, and will attend the AFL-CIO Hall of Fame dinner there in the evening as well. Saturday, 8/24, I'll walk with the Story County Democrats at the Lincoln Highway Days Parade in Nevada in the morning, and will then be one of the speakers at the Palo Alto Co Dems event from 430-8 pm at The Shores in Emmetsburg. Sunday 8/25, I'll be speaking at the Clay County Dems Picnic starting at 5 pm, and before that, I'm thinking I'll do some door knocking but I'm not sure where yet.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://iowastartingline.com/2024/08/09/miller-meeks-pharma/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!

clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended an anti-carbon capture pipeline rally in Buckeye, A postcard writing event in Marshalltown, the Humboldt Co Dems dinner in Humboldt, spoke with the leadership of the 4th District Dems via Zoom, had a get together with folks in Sibley in Osceola, spoke to a packed house at a house party in Blencoe in Monona County, and doorknocked with my friends Penny Vossler (who's running for state house) and Herman Quirmbach (current state senator) in Boone. The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Before I get to my postcard writing ask, a quick story from my door knocking in Boone Sunday. I knocked a Republican door, and met a nice guy in his 30's. I asked him what was top of mind for him, and he talked about his wife, who has Type 1 Diabetes. He talked about the immense cost of medicine, and how stressful it is considering he is a seasonal laborer. We then talked the role of politicians in that space. We discussed the efforts of the Biden administration to cap med costs, and how a Republican U.S. House Representative here in Iowa accepted a big donation from Big Pharma (link below) the same day she voted against that cap. We agreed that shouldn't even be a partisan issue, that it's just shameful that disproportionate corporate power continues to press its thumb on the scales everywhere we turn. My first bullet on the stances side of my hand out card I handed to him jumped out: I have always and will continue to reject corporate PAC money. Now, to the ask. Last campaign, thanks to my amazing volunteers, we sent out 5700 post cards. This campaign, as of now, volunteers have already committed to writing double that mark. Let's keep that momentum going! Post card writing for us is a very, very easy thing to do. My post cards have some of our major stances on one side, so the cards do much of the work for you already. My ask would just be that you write a simple note, and if possible, if you could cover the postage as an in kind contribution to help us out, as we're a grassroots campaign. We'll mail you the cards and the name & address list along with some basic prompts. We don't want to send a generic mailer as those typically get tossed in the garbage, but post cards written by someone are attention grabbers. If you're interested in helping us get the word out, please email me at melton4iowa@gmail.com and we'll get moving. If you'd like to help but aren't interested in writing for us, a donation would go a long way in buying more postcards. Thanks! Our schedule for this week: On Tuesday, 8/20, I'll attend an anti-carbon capture pipeline rally in Marathon put on by the Sierra Club at 6 pm. On Wednesday, 8/21, I'll be speaking at the Nevada Progressives Ice Cream Event at the library in town at 7 pm. On Thursday, 8/22, I'll be speaking at 2:45 at the AFL-CIO Convention at Prairie Meadows in Altoona, and will attend the AFL-CIO Hall of Fame dinner there in the evening as well. Saturday, 8/24, I'll walk with the Story County Democrats at the Lincoln Highway Days Parade in Nevada in the morning, and will then be one of the speakers at the Palo Alto Co Dems event from 430-8 pm at The Shores in Emmetsburg. Sunday 8/25, I'll be speaking at the Clay County Dems Picnic starting at 5 pm, and before that, I'm thinking I'll do some door knocking but I'm not sure where yet. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. **Peter, I’ve always said that poverty is a policy choice.**

1 in 10 New Yorkers facing food insecurity right now is a _policy choice._1

1 in every 83 New Yorkers facing homelessness right now is a _policy choice._2

These policy choices are rooted in _apathy,_ not _empathy._

Well Peter, it’s a lot easier to be apathetic when you don’t know what it’s like to live in dirty, vermin-infested public housing, or what it’s like to go to bed hungry. **_But I know exactly what that’s like._**

**And Georgia’s 8th district is no different.**

I’ve been in this community for years. I’ve seen firsthand how easily those in D.C. can forget about us. How quickly we fall off their radar once the election is over.

I saw families forced to move into motels after losing their jobs during the pandemic, and _I worked with them to find alternatives to housing._

As a mother and teacher, her experience being part of the second class to integrate Berkeley schools was a defining moment for me. Her story is an American story. name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
An update from a week where we knocked on doors in Rock County, visited the Kenosha County Fair, and a look ahead to our event with JD Vance tomorrow! | | | | |
---
| 78 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from a busy week on the campaign trail:
**Knocking Doors in Rock County** Knocking doors wins elections. It was great to see our hard-working volunteers in Rock County on Saturday morning.
---
| I’m thankful for their hard work knocking doors for our campaign and bringing our message directly to voters on the ground. Do you want to join us next time?
Click the link below!
---
[Knock Doors for Bryan Steil](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=49496bd562&e=e907534017)
| **Kenosha County Fair** The 103rd annual Kenosha County Fair was a blast! I especially had a great time working the concessions with the Lions Club.
---
| Can’t wait for the 104th Kenosha County Fair next year!
**JD Vance in Kenosha** Tomorrow, I’ll join JD Vance in Kenosha to discuss the importance of public safety. Everyone deserves to feel safe in their communities, and the 2020 Kenosha riots proves why it’s important to stand with law enforcement.
Interested in joining us at the press conference? Sign up using the link below.
---
[Join Bryan Steil and JD Vance in Kenosha](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=16e640f816&e=e907534017)
|
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

subject: FWD: This is how we keep Democrats locked out of power.

body:
Jim Jordan is working his tail off to get Donald Trump elected and grow our House Majority in November!
Jim Jordan really needs you to see this message!

|
---
| | |
Hey there,

Jim Jordan is working his tail off to get Donald Trump elected and grow our House Majority in November!

**So when he took time out of his day to craft this message to you, I knew it must be important!

Jim Jordan needs you to read this message, please take just a few minutes to hear him out.**

Best,
Tom

---
**\---------- Forwarded Message ---------**
